raw.title: Knowledge Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Associated Bank we strive to create an inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued and recognized as strengths critical to our success.
raw.description:
At Associated Bank we strive to create an inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued and recognized as strengths critical to our success. If you thrive in an environment where your growth and development are encouraged and supported, then Associated Bank may be the right place for you.

Associated Bank requires you to directly represent yourself and your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process. Associated Bank conducts a thorough background check on all new hires.

Role Summary

As a Knowledge Engineer, you'll help build the foundation that enables data to be trusted, connected, and understood across the organization. You'll partner with business and technology teams to create shared data definitions and semantic models that improve decision-making, governance, and AI capabilities. This is an exciting opportunity to influence enterprise data strategy while growing your expertise in modern data and knowledge technologies.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop enterprise semantic models, ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graph structures that create consistent business meaning across data domains.

  • Define and maintain enterprise business concepts, metadata standards, and data relationships to support governance and regulatory compliance.

  • Align data from multiple systems by mapping technical data to shared business definitions and reusable semantic standards.

  • Partner with data architecture, engineering, governance, AI, and business teams to translate business needs into scalable semantic solutions.

  • Enable advanced data discovery and analytics by applying semantic web standards, graph technologies, and knowledge modeling practices.

  • Support AI-ready data capabilities by designing semantic frameworks that improve context, search, and knowledge-driven insights.

  • Promote enterprise data consistency by advancing metadata, lineage, and governance best practices across the organization.

Education & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Knowledge Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 3+ years of experience with semantic technologies, data modeling, knowledge representation, graph databases, and semantic web standards.

  • 3+ years of experience working with modern data platforms and collaborating across data architecture, engineering, and governance teams to deliver enterprise data solutions.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science or a related discipline.

  • 1+ years of experience implementing or managing enterprise knowledge graph platforms or semantic technologies.

  • 1+ years of experience supporting enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, and data quality initiatives.

  • Neo4j Certified Professional certification.

  • SnowPro Advanced certification.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Associated Bank, you'll collaborate with talented professionals who are passionate about solving meaningful business challenges through innovation and teamwork. We invest in your development with opportunities to expand your technical expertise, grow your career, and make a lasting impact on enterprise data strategy. Apply today to make an impact.

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified parties, including but not limited to people returning to the workforce, people with disabilities, those without a college degree, and veterans or those with military experience.

In addition to core traditional benefits, we take pride in offering benefits for every stage of life.

  • Retirement savings including both 401(k) and Pension plans.

  • Paid time off to volunteer in your community.

  • Opportunities to connect with others through our diversity-focused Colleague Resource Groups.

  • Competitive salaries with professional development and advancement opportunities.

  • Bonus benefits including well-being programs and incentives, parental leave, an employee stock purchase plan, military benefits and much more.

  • Personal banking, loan, investment and insurance benefits.

Associated Bank serves more than 120 communities throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, Minnesota, and Missouri and we consider our colleagues critical to our continued success. See why our colleagues continually vote us a best place to work in the Midwest. Join our community on Facebook, LinkedIn and X. 

Compliance Statement

Associated Bank is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse workforce. We support a work environment where colleagues are respected and given the opportunity to perform to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, among other factors.

Fully complies with all applicable enterprise policies and procedures. Acts in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as outlined in training materials, including but not limited to Bank Secrecy Act. Responsible for reporting suspicious activity to Financial Intelligence. Responsible to report all customer complaints as prescribed and procedure violations to management or HR.

Responsible to report ethical concerns as needed to Associated Bank’s anonymous Ethics Hotline.

Associated Bank provides additional assistance throughout the application, interview and hiring process. Please contact if you need an accommodation at any time during the process.

Associated Banc-Corp participates in the E-Verify Program. E-Verify Notice English or Spanish. Know Your Right to Work English or Spanish.

Associated Bank is Pay Transparency compliant.


The pay range represents anticipated base pay for this role. Actual pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, work location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role.


For certain positions, total compensation may also include incentive, commission, or bonus opportunities not reflected in the posted base pay range.


$92,610.00 - $158,760.00 per year

Job Profile:

Software Engineering Manager

Job Description Summary:

We are committed to providing a competitive and equitable total rewards package. The compensation for this role is designed to attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

The expected base salary range for this position is $180,000 to $240,000 annually.

Job Description:

Why Rate is the BEST Place to Work

Rate is one of the nation’s top retail mortgage lenders, delivering a seamless, tech-driven experience that helps customers reach their homeownership and financial goals. Founded in 2000 and based in Chicago, Rate is licensed in all 50 states and D.C. and has helped over 2 million homeowners with a wide range of loan products, competitive rates and personalized service. With 5,000+ employees across 300+ offices and 12+ subsidiaries, Rate’s Loan Officers rank among the best in the country. From purchases and refinances to tapping into equity, Rate makes financing faster, simpler and less stressful. Our technology — including Same Day Mortgage, the Rate App, FlashClose℠, MyAccount and the Language Access Program — has earned recognition from HousingWire, Scotsman Guide, NerdWallet, the Chicago Tribune and Crain’s Chicago Business. Learn more at rate.com.

What Makes Our Team Awesome

We are a gritty group of passionate technologists on a mission to dominate the mortgage world!

The Information Technology Team within Rate passionately and consistently puts our customers first. We are building the latest technology to help create the best mortgage experience on the planet and get your mortgage, your way, anytime, anywhere. Whether that is improving our digital mortgage platform, automating loan coordination and underwriting processes, or building out the latest marketing and customer engagement platform, we’re doing it all. We build high-performing, self-organized, cross-functional agile teams that operate with minimal hierarchy. Information Technology team members hold themselves and others accountable and live and breathe the tenets of autonomy, mastery, and purpose.

What’s the Role?

We are looking for a Hands-On Software Engineering Manager who thrives in both leadership and code. In this role, you'll lead a team of talented engineers while actively contributing to architecture, design, and development of our core systems. You’ll play a key role in scaling the team, ensuring technical excellence, and driving product innovation from concept to deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead by example — Write, review, and ship production-quality code regularly (~30–50% of time).
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver features that drive business outcomes.
  • Mentor, coach, and grow engineers through regular 1:1s, career planning, and technical feedback.
  • Drive the team to use AI methods to increase the overall development productivity
  • Own team execution and delivery: set priorities, remove blockers, and keep projects on track.
  • Define and drive engineering best practices including testing, CI/CD, system design, and code quality.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and help shape long-term technical direction.
  • Recruit and onboard top engineering talent.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software development experience, with strong full-stack or backend development skills.
  • 4+ years in an engineering leadership or team lead role with direct reports.
  • Deep expertise in Java, React, Node.js, Python etc. Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, or containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience designing scalable systems and working with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • AI driven development experience
  • Strong communication and people skills; you can inspire and align both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Startup or high-growth company experience is a plus.

Pay Range: annual pay + bonus and/or commissions

Location: Remote

Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

Annotation is what helps AI make sense of the world. As an annotator, you may be invited to take part in online projects such as rating AI-generated content, evaluating factual accuracy, or comparing responses — when projects are available.

While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Carefully review provided data (text, images, or videos);
  • Label or classify content based on project guidelines;
  • Identify and flag factually incorrect, sensitive, inappropriate, or unclear material.

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for candidates open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline;
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in any professional role;
  • Logical thinking, fact-checking and reasoning abilities;
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to understand and follow complex instructions;
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions when needed;
  • Genuine interest in technology and artificial intelligence;
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1+).

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project (when available) → Complete tasks → Get paid

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments;
  • Participate into advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio;
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $8/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate. Keep in mind, quality standards must be maintained, regardless of speed.

raw.title: Service Desk Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators.
raw.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Service Desk Operations Manager is a senior leader responsible for end-to-end IT Service Desk operations, ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery through internal teams and managed service partners.

In this role, you will own contractual service-level performance, reporting and analytics, incident management, including coordination of major incident response, and monitoring of operational process execution. You will serve as a strategic leader and a hands-on operational manager. Additionally, you will oversee technical platform requirements, testing, and delivery for the IT Service Desk team.

You will ensure service desk and business operations functions, including incident management, service requests, and support services, are delivered in alignment with service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and customer experience expectations. You will also drive continuous improvements through process optimization and data-driven decision-making. You will report to the Assistant Vice President ITS Service Desk & Support Operations.

What you'll do:

Leadership & Service Desk Operations

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of service desk professionals, driving accountability, performance, and engagement
  • Own day-to-day operations, including queue health, ticket management, prioritization, and workload balancing
  • Be an a hands-on leader, actively engaging in escalations, incident response, and operational decision-making

Contractual Service Level Management

  • Own and govern Service Level Management (SLM) processes for the managed service partner and internal operations
  • Monitor SLA/KPI performance (response, resolution, backlog, CSAT) and drive corrective actions to meet established contractual obligations
  • Drive operational adjustments, process changes, and prioritization decisions to consistently meet or exceed service targets

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain operational dashboards and reporting frameworks leveraging ServiceNow, Five9, and related tools with strong collaboration with Platform Owners to align Service Desk requirements and tool capabilities
  • Translate data into insights that inform staffing, service design, and operational improvements
  • Analyze trends in volume, SLA adherence, incident patterns, and customer feedback to proactively manage performance
  • Establish a strong data-driven operating model, enabling leadership visibility into service health and risks
  • Deliver regular reporting to leadership on performance outcomes, trends, and improvement opportunities

Incident Control & Escalation Management

  • Provide leadership oversight for incident management, escalation handling, and major incident response
  • Be a senior escalation point to ensure timely restoration and communication during service disruptions
  • Ensure adherence to incident prioritization, routing, and escalation standards aligned to ITIL practices
  • Oversee operational controls related to ticket flow, backlog management, and queue governance

Process Execution Monitoring & Optimization

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Service Desk operations
  • Serve as Process Repository Owner, ensuring documentation standards, governance, and lifecycle management
  • Monitor process execution and adherence, ensuring consistency across Service Desk operations
  • Identify inefficiencies and drive process optimization and standardization
  • Establish and enforce change control and communication practices for process updates

Partnerships

  • Maintain an operational leadership role in management of the IT Service Desk managed services provider
  • Partner closely with Service Experience Owners to translate quality insights into process, technology, and training improvements
  • Partner with Knowledge Enablement to ensure training programs align to operational needs, performance trends, and service changes
  • Partner with Platform and Process Owners to align engagement and interaction in Service Desk escalation processes
  • Integrate training strategies with quality findings, process updates, and new technology implementations
  • Other responsibilities as assigned

What we're looking for:

  • 10 years of relevant experience in business process ownership, documenting, executing or automating
  • 1 year of experience leading teams and operational functions in a complex service environment
  • Advanced knowledge of service workflows, and support models
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field or equivalent of experience in lieu of degree
  • Experience managing service delivery in large, complex environments, including managed service providers
  • Strong track record in SLA management, reporting & analytics (Service Now or Power BI), and operational performance improvement
  • Experience improving processes and driving efficiency such as through LEAN methodologies.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

Compensation

The annual pay range for this position is $85,563.00 - $136,928.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $94,548.00 - $127,918.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

  • Mental health and wellbeing resources

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a supportive team member for Regional Intelligence

  • Performs tasks for multiple Site Intelligence and Feasibility projects.

  • Able to manage a high volume of complex studies and sites

  • Works under close supervision of Regional Intelligence Team Lead, and where needed the Feasibility Specialist Point of Contact (POC)

  • Contributes to executing Site Feasibility plans and presenting the data to colleagues.

  • Supports the Feasibility Strategy & Analytics Lead (FSAL) to ensure knowledge of goals, scope and requirements of the Site Feasibility project are understood, and ensures that high quality results are executed and delivered.

  • Applies skills and discipline knowledge to OARS and Regional Intelligence development projects

  • Promotes a continuous improvement culture to streamline appropriate processes for maximum efficiency and productivity

  • Develops and maintains internal processes aimed to optimize country & site selection activities

  • Creates awareness by working as a cross functional team leader to deliver data, analytics and regional site intelligence initiatives across a broad spectrum of stakeholders, both internal and external

  • Contribution to wider initiatives, both technology and process improvement components

  • Runs operational and technical aspects of large global projects and assists with other Company systems activities related to site intelligence

  • Maintains effective relationships with other platform lines, Business Units/Research Units, and enabling lines that facilitates effective portfolio delivery

  • Partners with GSSO and CD&O teams to improve overall study start up metrics and implement simple processes

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • In general, candidates for this job would have the following levels of experience in Clinical Research/Clinical Operations: 2-3 years

  • Fluent in English and Polish

  • Manager/Senior Associate: Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or CRO in a similar role

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and stakeholders both inside and outside of the organization

  • Strong presentation skills, interpersonal skills, as well as a team oriented approach. Excellent verbal, written, communication and time management skills

  • Ability to multitask under tight deadlines on several projects with specific and unique requirements, while providing attention to detail and high quality work

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in a clinical research organization and related therapeutic specialties with familiarity in principles, concepts, practices and standards.

  • Prior feasibility experience

  • An eye for detail and ability to problem solve operational challenges and provide high level insights to a multidisciplinary team.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft SharePoint

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, database applications)

  • A quick learner with the desire to contribute and support the design and implementation of analytical insights and management of data platforms.

  • Demonstrated success/results in prior roles including matrix organization

Organizational Relationships:

  • Collaborates across functional lines within CD&O, R&D, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), Legal and Quality Representatives, and Functional Service Providers (FSPs).

  • Works under supervision of Regional Intelligence Team Lead

  • Global Study Manager, Start-Up Project Manager, Global Study Clinician

  • Local Site Relationship Partners and Director Clinical Site Operations (DCSO), Clinical Trials Manager and other Local Roles

  • Global Quality and Event representatives

  • Feasibility Strategy & Analytics Lead (FSAL) & Due Diligence Lead

raw.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

National Advanced Clinical Education Specialist (N-ACES) – Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO)

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Abbott Electrophysiology is dedicated to restoring health and improving quality of life through innovative solutions that advance the standard of care. As the leader in Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO), Abbott continues to expand access to life-changing stroke prevention therapies through the Amplatzer™ Amulet™ LAA Occluder.

The National Advanced Clinical Education Specialist (N-ACES) – LAAO serves as a national clinical leader responsible for the strategic development, execution, and continuous improvement of clinical education programs supporting Abbott’s LAA franchise. This role partners closely with Commercial Leadership, Professional Education, Marketing, Clinical Research, Sales Training, and the field clinical organization to ensure excellence in procedural execution, physician education, and field competency development.

The N-ACES will act as a national subject matter expert for Amulet procedures, providing leadership in clinical strategy, field force development, customer education, and best-practice dissemination. This individual will play a critical role in scaling clinical excellence across the organization while supporting the successful adoption and growth of Abbott's LAA therapies.

This position requires extensive collaboration across commercial and clinical functions and will involve travel up to 60%.

What You'll Do

Clinical Education Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of national clinical education strategies for Abbott's LAA franchise.
  • Design, implement, and continuously enhance educational pathways supporting Amulet procedural success.
  • Establish and maintain competency frameworks for Clinical Specialists and Territory Managers supporting LAA accounts.
  • Develop standardized training materials, procedural guides, best practices, and advanced educational content.
  • Partner with Professional Education and Commercial Development teams to align field education with strategic business objectives.

Field Force Development

  • Serve as the clinical development leader for the LAA field organization.

raw.description:
Full Stack Engineer (Next.js, React, Python, AI & Marketing Tech) – Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a fast-growing marketing agency serving 150+ home service businesses — is hiring a hands-on Full Stack Engineer to build internal tools, marketing technology, AI-powered workflows, and automation systems.

This is a builder role, not a strategy-only position.

You’ll work directly across:

  • Full-stack application development
  • Marketing data and attribution
  • Meta Pixel & Conversion API (CAPI)
  • CRM integrations and automation
  • AI-powered marketing workflows
  • Internal dashboards and reporting tools

You’ll collaborate closely with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn operational challenges into production-ready systems that directly improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and efficiency.

What You’ll Own

Full Stack & Internal Tool Development

  • Build and deploy production-ready internal tools using:
    • Next.js
    • React
    • Python
  • Develop:
    • Marketing dashboards
    • Reporting systems
    • Internal operational tools
    • Workflow automation
  • Replace repetitive manual processes with scalable software solutions
  • Build reliable systems used directly by media buyers and operational teams

Marketing Tracking, Data & Attribution

  • Implement and optimize:
    • Meta Pixel
    • Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Manage:
    • Event tracking
    • Event deduplication
    • Conversion attribution
    • Offline conversion syncing
  • Build data pipelines connecting:
    • Ad platforms
    • Backend systems
    • CRMs
    • Reporting dashboards
  • Ensure campaign data remains accurate and actionable
  • Support reporting across metrics such as:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead quality

CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation

  • Build integrations with CRM platforms such as:
    • GoHighLevel
    • Close CRM
    • HubSpot
    • Similar platforms
  • Connect the full lead lifecycle:
    • Lead capture
    • CRM entry
    • Lead routing
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline progression
    • Conversion tracking
  • Build automations using APIs and webhooks
  • Sync CRM outcomes back to advertising platforms for attribution and optimization
  • Maintain data consistency across CRM, marketing, and reporting systems

AI Integration & Automation

  • Integrate AI into real-world marketing workflows
  • Work with APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms
  • Build AI-powered systems for:
    • Ad copy generation
    • Creative generation workflows
    • Lead scoring
    • Lead qualification
    • Campaign analysis
    • Automated reporting and insights
  • Embed AI capabilities into production marketing and operational systems
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through intelligent automation

Rapid Development & Iteration

  • Ship working solutions quickly and iterate based on real-world usage
  • Work directly with media buyers to identify campaign bottlenecks
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting:
    • Tracking
    • Attribution
    • CRM workflows
    • Reporting
    • Lead conversion
  • Continuously improve internal systems based on campaign data and team feedback

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack development experience with:
    • React
    • Next.js
    • Python
  • Proven experience building and deploying production-level applications or internal tools
  • Strong experience with:
    • APIs
    • Webhooks
    • System integrations
    • Automation workflows
  • Active use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work
  • Hands-on experience in a marketing, advertising, or ad-tech environment
  • Experience with Meta Pixel and/or Conversion API (CAPI), including:
    • Event tracking
    • Deduplication
    • Attribution
  • Experience building marketing dashboards or reporting systems
  • Hands-on CRM integration experience with platforms such as:
    • GoHighLevel
    • Close
    • HubSpot
  • Experience automating:
    • Lead capture
    • Lead routing
    • Pipeline management
    • Conversion tracking
  • Experience connecting advertising platforms with CRM systems for attribution and reporting
  • Strong builder mindset with a bias toward execution

Nice to Have

  • Performance marketing agency experience
  • Experience supporting high-volume paid advertising campaigns
  • Understanding of:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead quality
  • Experience with:
    • Zapier
    • Make
    • Similar automation platforms
  • Understanding of marketing data pipelines
  • Familiarity with attribution challenges related to:
    • iOS privacy changes
    • Browser tracking limitations
    • Server-side tracking
  • Experience developing AI-powered internal tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re an engineer who enjoys building and shipping, not just planning architecture
  • You understand both software engineering and the realities of performance marketing
  • You know how marketing data moves between ad platforms, backend systems, and CRMs
  • You can troubleshoot attribution and tracking problems
  • You’re comfortable integrating APIs and automating complex workflows
  • You actively use AI to improve engineering speed and business processes
  • You can work directly with non-technical teams such as media buyers and marketers
  • You move quickly without sacrificing reliability

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing tracking data and investigating an attribution discrepancy between Meta Ads and the CRM.

Later, you could build a new Next.js dashboard for media buyers, implement a Python service that scores incoming leads using AI, or create a webhook integration that sends CRM conversion outcomes back through Meta CAPI.

You’ll work closely with media buyers and leadership to identify bottlenecks, build solutions, deploy them, and iterate based on real campaign performance.

In short: you build the technology connecting advertising, CRM, AI, data, and operations — helping the agency run faster and make better marketing decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Internal tools actively adopted by media buyers and operators
  • Accurate Meta Pixel/CAPI tracking and attribution
  • Reliable CRM and advertising-platform data synchronization
  • Reduction in manual marketing and operational workflows
  • Faster campaign reporting and execution
  • Improved lead tracking and conversion visibility
  • Successful deployment of AI-powered workflows
  • Reliability and scalability of production systems

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Build technology directly tied to marketing performance and revenue
  • Work across software engineering + AI + ad tech
  • High ownership over internal products and systems
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and performance marketing teams
  • Opportunity to build AI systems used in real production workflows
  • Work with marketing operations supporting 150+ home service businesses
  • Fully remote environment with significant autonomy

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re a Full Stack Engineer with strong React, Next.js, and Python skills who has hands-on experience with marketing technology, Meta CAPI, CRM integrations, attribution, and AI-powered automation, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and build systems that directly improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and operational efficiency.

Program Development & Process Improvement

Additional Duties

  • Ensure all services meet clinical, ethical, and regulatory standards
  • Adapt to evolving technology and telehealth best practices

raw.description:
Mid-Market Account Executive, SLED

TCP is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive team. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

About TCP (TimeClock Plus)

For more than 30 years, TCP has helped organizations engage their people by providing flexible, mobile timekeeping and workforce management solutions. Trusted by tens of thousands of customers and millions of users, TCP delivers proven technology and personalized support to organizations of all sizes in the public and private sector to meet their complex timekeeping, employee scheduling, leave management and other workforce needs. We recently embraced our refreshed brand, and completed our acquisition of Humanity Schedule, a cloud-based scheduling platform. Growth is happening and our vision for the future is clear. We'd love you to join us on this journey. For more information, visit or follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook.

The Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive, SLED, you'll be responsible for driving and closing business, generating new leads and managing your growing pipeline. You will be the face of TCP to your customers and prospects and act as their main point of contact through the full sales cycle. We are looking for candidates with a "hunter" mentality, a drive to succeed and grow professionally, and a positive, self-starting mindset. If you have 3-5 years of successful SaaS sales experience and crushed both your rookie year and your fully ramped year, we would love to chat with you.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and advisor to prospective customers through knowledge of current trends and topics within your assigned market segment.
  • Develop and execute a strategic territory plan focused on State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts, building relationships with key stakeholders and driving net-new business.
  • Navigate complex SLED procurement processes, including RFPs, cooperative purchasing agreements, and budget cycles, to position and close workforce management solutions.
  • Use a consultative approach to uncover workforce management challenges within SLED organizations and match them to solutions that deliver measurable results.
  • Drive recurring subscription revenue through new customers.
  • Achieve and exceed your assigned sales revenue quota.
  • Conduct needs assessments across multiple customer groups, including technical, line-of-business, and executive stakeholders.
  • Communicate the features and benefits of our software products clearly.
  • Maintain an organized database of accounts, opportunities, and associated activities.
  • Deliver customized presentations and product demonstrations.
  • Manage, track, and accurately forecast revenue opportunities.
  • Communicate a compelling, concise value proposition to potential customers.
  • Promote TCP and its capabilities to your assigned market segments.
  • Focus on prospecting and outbound sales generation.
  • Complete a minimum of 25 prospecting calls per day. This is a daily minimum, not a weekly average.
  • Maintain a sales mix of 80% self-generated business, 10% marketing and inbound leads, and 10% partnerships.
  • Own territory planning and management.

• Travel 20-30%.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree preferred.

  • 3-5 years of experience selling SaaS and running the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to a completed agreement.
  • Track record of building pipeline at 3-5x quota.
  • Ability to create and assess sales opportunities through a consultative approach.
  • Exceptional telephone and interpersonal communication skills.
  • The drive and organizational skills to maintain a high volume of daily outbound calls and emails.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools such as Salesforce a plus.

What We're Looking For

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and a good listener who takes initiative.
  • Highly motivated, results-oriented, and high-integrity.
  • A captivating storyteller who connects through personal engagement.
  • Eager to be both a mentor and a student, contributing to the collective success of the team.
  • Outgoing, high-energy personality who enjoys new adventures and helping others solve problems.
  • A "how can I help?" attitude and a willingness to think outside the box for customers.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus uncapped commission.
  • 20 days of PTO and 13 companywide holidays.
  • 8 hours to volunteer and impact the community.
  • Comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401K).

• Employee Choice Benefit.

raw.description:
About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Odia
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: Find a publicly accessible Odia PDF in an assigned document type with multimodal elements. Record the source.
  • Annotate structure: Identify and bound every meaningful region of the page. Assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: Link each region to its parent component, such as a figure or table.
  • Transcribe faithfully: Reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Odia script, including handwritten content. Flag any illegible regions.
  • Capture page metadata: Document language, type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: Conduct end-to-end reviews of tasks by a second Odia expert.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Odia speaker with full command of the script.
  • Experience in annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy.
  • Systematic application of taxonomy across pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like multi-column newspapers and handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Experience with regional-language AI data annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction, or post-editing.
  • Document production skills: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Odia-language material.
  • Knowledge of script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Odia input methods, numeral-form, and character-form accuracy.

Application Process (Takes 20–30 mins to complete)

  • Upload resume
  • AI interview based on your resume
  • Submit form

Resources & Support

  • For any help or support, reach out to:

raw.description:
Inbound Sales & Customer Service Representative (Home Services) – Remote

Inbound Sales | Customer Service | Appointment Setting | Call Center | CRM

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Evenings + Weekend Rotation Required)

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for an Inbound Sales & Customer Service Representative to manage high-volume inbound calls, assist customers with home service needs, and convert conversations into booked service appointments and membership enrollments.

This is more than a customer support role. You’ll be responsible for turning inbound inquiries into revenue by providing exceptional service, recommending the right solutions, and confidently guiding customers toward scheduling appointments and joining the company’s membership program.

You’ll work closely with dispatch, operations, and customer service teams to ensure every customer receives a seamless experience from their first call through appointment scheduling.

If you’re confident on the phone, naturally persuasive, and enjoy helping customers while achieving measurable sales goals, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Sales & Customer Support

  • Handle high-volume inbound calls professionally and efficiently.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend the most appropriate services.
  • Build trust quickly through friendly, consultative conversations.
  • Guide customers toward booking service appointments using structured call flows.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service while achieving sales objectives.

Appointment Scheduling & Membership Sales

  • Schedule service appointments accurately and efficiently.
  • Introduce and explain the company’s membership program (Pipeline Club).
  • Identify opportunities to upsell additional services and maintenance plans.
  • Balance customer satisfaction with sales performance on every interaction.
  • Ensure scheduling details are accurate and complete.

CRM & Customer Data Management

  • Accurately log customer interactions, appointments, and notes in CRM systems.
  • Maintain complete and up-to-date customer records.
  • Follow company workflows, SOPs, and quality standards.
  • Ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.

Customer Experience & Issue Resolution

  • Handle objections professionally and confidently.
  • De-escalate challenging customer situations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Follow up on customer requests when required.
  • Deliver a consistently positive customer experience that builds trust and loyalty.

Team Collaboration

  • Coordinate closely with dispatch and operations teams.
  • Communicate scheduling updates and customer information accurately.
  • Share customer feedback to improve scripts, processes, and service delivery.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-performing remote team environment.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 1–2+ years of experience in:
    • Inbound Sales
    • Customer Service
    • Call Center Operations
    • Appointment Setting
    • Customer Support with Sales Targets

Core Skills

  • Proven ability to convert inbound calls into booked appointments.
  • Strong objection handling and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Comfortable working in a high-volume call environment.
  • Experience using CRM or customer management systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in:
    • Plumbing
    • HVAC
    • Electrical
    • Home Services
  • Experience using:
    • ServiceTitan
    • Housecall Pro
    • Service Fusion
  • Membership or subscription sales experience.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based customers.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Confident and persuasive communicator.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong sales instincts.
  • Comfortable working toward measurable sales goals.
  • Calm under pressure and skilled at handling objections.
  • Organized, dependable, and coachable.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, call-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Answer inbound customer calls throughout your shift.
  • Understand customer issues and recommend appropriate services.
  • Schedule appointments and present membership options.
  • Update CRM records and customer information.
  • Follow structured call flows and sales processes.
  • Collaborate with dispatch and operations to ensure smooth service delivery.
  • Monitor personal performance metrics and continuously improve.

In short: You turn inbound customer inquiries into booked appointments, membership sales, and exceptional customer experiences.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Call-to-booking conversion rate.
  • Membership (Pipeline Club) conversion rate.
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT).
  • Call quality and QA scores.
  • CRM accuracy and documentation completeness.
  • Schedule accuracy and booking quality.
  • Consistent achievement of sales and service goals.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.
  • Structured training, proven scripts, and ongoing coaching.
  • Opportunity to build valuable inbound sales and customer service skills.
  • Direct impact on customer satisfaction and company revenue.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Customer Service Representative
    • Inbound Sales Specialist
    • Team Lead
    • Sales Supervisor
    • Operations Coordinator

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re someone who enjoys helping customers, excels at building trust over the phone, and can confidently turn inbound conversations into booked appointments and sales, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become an essential part of a high-performing customer experience and sales team.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

Job Description

Under the direction of the IS Leadership Team, the Headquarters IS Business Office Lead will partner and collaborate with all levels of IS management and staff to ensure proper financial, inventory, procurement, contract, and asset management functions are performed in line with department and institutional standards and policies. The Business Office Lead will supervise staff that will perform department wide planning and analysis as well as serve as primary liaison for all competitive bidding, contract review, procurement, vendor management, and asset management activities The IS Business Office Lead will be responsible for the day to day operations of the IS Business Office ensuring department wide information is readily available for critical decision making, procurement justifications, and audit activities.

Key Responsiblities:

  • Oversees and coordinates IS Business Office to include Contracting, Procurement, Asset Management, and Budgeting functions in support of the Headquarter IS department and IS departments at SHC Sites.

  • Leads and drives the adoption of standard business practices and workflows across the department and with other SHC departments and SHC Sites as it pertains to Business Management functions

  • Supervises, mentors, and develops staff to achieve departmental and professional goals

  • Participates in strategic sourcing, budgeting, and long-term planning where appropriate with a goal of optimizing our vendor relations and financial performance

  • Ensures IS agreements reflect SHC standard IS business terms.

  • Communicates effectively with key stakeholders, business owners, and Leadership, maintaining key internal and external customer relationships

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 or more years of experience in an institution with a large IS organization

  • 2 or more years of experience in a Team lead or Supervisor role in healthcare business environment focused on procurement and finance activities

  • 5 or more years of hands-on experience with IS contract review, negotiation and procurement activities

  • Bachelor's Degree

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

Senior Technology Content Specialist

The Senior Technology Content Specialist supports Curriculum Associates' adoptions and proposals efforts by completing technology rubrics and forms required by states and districts, drafting and refining the technology sections of RFP narratives, and partnering with the Technology Content Manager to keep boilerplate content current, accurate, and aligned with product updates.

  • Draft, edit, and finalize the assigned technology sections of RFP narratives in coordination with proposal writers and subject matter experts

  • Support the Technology Content Manager in maintaining and updating the technology boilerplate library, ensuring content reflects current product capabilities, system requirements, and data security practices

  • Collaborate with Product, IT, Legal, Infosec and other stakeholders to gather accurate, up-to-date technical information for rubric, questionnaire, and proposal use

  • Support ad hoc research requests related to state technology requirements, accessibility standards, or data privacy provisions relevant to bids and business needs

  • Assist with quality checks on final proposal documents to confirm technology section responses align with requirements

  • Other relevant duties, as assigned

Who we're looking for:

  • Working knowledge of K-12 edtech product categories (LMS, SIS, assessment platforms, instructional software)

  • Ability to read and interpret technical product documentation, release notes, or specs from engineering/product teams

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, respond to multiple constituencies, and meet established deadlines

Pay Range – This role’s range is $60,750 - $99,750.

At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. raw.description:
Location: Europe. Being in the UK, Germany or Sweden is a small plus for market proximity and occasional travel, but it is not a requirement.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches and develops market-leading pet and equestrian marketplaces globally. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and some of our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we are on a mission to transform this process by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through innovative technology. We are a driven and ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by top-tier investors such as Verdane. As a company, we have been profitable since our first year, meaning we do not rely on investor capital for our growth.

The opportunity

This is our first dedicated PR hire and it covers the whole group. Over the years, PMG has managed to reduce animal welfare issues on our platforms far below any peer, through ID verification of breeders, AI-assisted moderation of adverts, a zero-tolerance approach to illegal puppy imports and unlicensed high-volume breeding, and by going far beyond what the law requires. Your job is to tell the world about it.

We know the playbook works because we have already done it once. In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling. You bring an AI-forward mindset, the instinct to ask how can I leverage myself through AI, and you use it daily for data analysis, drafting, localising, and getting a story out across markets, so covering seven markets does not mean seven times the work.

What you will do

  • Turn our marketplace data into publishable stories: pricing and demand trends, breed rankings, most popular puppy names, buyer surveys on preferences and the like. One shared instrument based on real-time data and identical core survey questions across markets.

  • Build and run the group editorial calendar, planned per market around seasonal hooks such as heatwaves, fireworks, International Puppy Day and so on, so we are ready before the news cycle asks.

  • Own our trust and safety transparency reporting: listings blocked, scams intercepted, buyer money protected, illegal import patterns by origin, for distribution to journalists and animal welfare stakeholders alike.

  • Mine breeder reviews, Trustpilot and support conversations for the human stories regional press actually run.

  • Become PMG's press desk, so the journalist relationship belongs to PMG rather than to an agency.

  • Brief and equip country leads and founders as spokespeople: talking points, Q&A, data appendices, prep before interviews.

Requirements

Must-have experience

  • 5+ years in PR, communications or journalism, preferably in-house, with coverage in national or major regional media that you personally landed. Data journalism experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of building stories out of data rather than distributing press releases. You can spot the angle a journalist will want before they ask, and you are comfortable enough with spreadsheets and dashboards to find it yourself and sanity check a number before a reporter does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, drafting, localisation and workflow automation. You think in terms of how to leverage yourself through AI, not around it, with a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Native-level English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a journalist.

  • Able to operate as a team of one: briefing agencies and freelancers and holding them to account, rather than managing staff beneath you.

Preferable experience

  • Experience in a reputation-exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, gambling, fintech or the gig economy, or in a category under active regulatory or campaigner scrutiny.

  • Experience running consumer surveys with panels or survey tools.

  • Digital PR fundamentals: earned links, newsjacking, syndication.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands-on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • A function that does not exist yet, yours to design, across seven markets, with a proven UK playbook to build from.

  • A proprietary dataset covering millions of pet and horse transactions that no journalist can get anywhere else.

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

Commercial Project Controls & Coordination Manager

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT

SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience


THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT CONTROLS & COORDINATION MANAGER

SunStrong Management is seeking a remote Commercial Project Controls & Coordination Manager. SunStrong delivers technical asset management and operations for a renewable portfolio spanning solar, battery energy storage, wind, and EV infrastructure. Project Delivery reports into Commercial Operations by design: the organization that will operate an asset for thirty years controls the standard by which it is accepted at twelve months.
The Manager of Project Controls & Coordination owns the integrity of the information the delivery organization runs on — schedule, cost, change, contract terms — and the operating discipline of the registers that trace every commitment and every open item to closure. The role is the reason a gate decision can be made on evidence rather than on a contractor's summary.
The role deliberately combines two distinct bodies of work: an analytical function that independently baselines, recalculates, and reports variance, and a coordination function that maintains the registers, the document vault, and the meeting and reporting cadence. This is a single role by design at current portfolio scale, with a defined trigger for splitting it. The candidate profile is analytical first — coordination discipline can be taught to an analyst; analytical judgment cannot be taught to a coordinator.COMMERCIAL PROJECT CONTROLS & COORDINATION MANAGER RESPONSIBILITIES

Analytical — Schedule Control

  • Establish and maintain the integrated project schedule baseline; control all baseline changes through a documented change process.
  • Review EPC-submitted schedules for logic integrity — open ends, constraints, negative float, excessive lags, and critical path credibility. A schedule accepted without interrogation is a schedule written for the contractor.
  • Maintain the portfolio milestone and gate forecast; identify projected slip against COD, lender, tax equity, and host commitments early enough that it is a decision rather than an emergency.
  • Perform schedule variance and trend analysis; distinguish recoverable slip from structural slip and state which is which.
  • Verify that three-week lookaheads reconcile to the master schedule rather than describing a parallel reality.

Analytical — Cost Control

  • Own the project cost baseline, commitment tracking, actual cost capture, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Maintain earned value methodology across the portfolio; report SPI, CPI, and forecast at completion with a stated basis.
  • Review EPC payment applications against verified physical progress, milestone achievement, and retainage terms before release.
  • Maintain the retainage and punchlist hold register, including SSM independent cost estimates supporting Category B and C holds.
  • Support capital forecasting and cash flow projection with Finance and Asset Management.

Analytical — Change Control

  • Own the change order log from request through disposition, with schedule and cost impact independently assessed rather than accepted as submitted.
  • Analyze each change against the contracted scope to determine whether it is genuine added scope, a scope gap the EPC should have caught, or a contractor estimating error.
  • Track cumulative change against delegated authority thresholds and flag approaching limits before they are exceeded.
  • Maintain change trend analysis by contractor as a direct input to the EPC performance scorecard.

Analytical — Contract Abstraction

  • Abstract every EPC agreement into the standard term register within fifteen business days of intake — completion definitions, performance guarantees, testing methodology, liquidated damages, retainage, warranty, notice requirements, and change authority.
  • Identify and log Baseline Exposures where the contract as written falls short of the SSM acceptance standard; assign owners and track mitigation.
  • Maintain the warranty register with expiration tracking and claim window alerting. A claim window that closes unnoticed is a direct loss and is treated as one.
  • Maintain the delivery risk register with quantified exposure and mitigation status.

Coordination — Registers and Document Control

  • Own the punchlist register system — structure, field standards, data integrity, aging reporting, and completeness of closure evidence across all projects.
  • Maintain register hygiene: no orphaned IDs, no renumbering, no items closed without a verifier and an evidence reference.
  • Drive aging follow-up across punchlist, RFI, submittal, and nonconformance logs; escalate items breaching aging thresholds rather than reporting them indefinitely.
  • Own the project document vault — filing standard, naming convention, version control, access control.
  • Maintain the equipment register — serial numbers, network addresses, warranty start dates — as construction data lands.

Coordination — Cadence and Reporting Production

  • Produce the monthly owner project review package and the weekly gate and variance reporting.
  • Coordinate the weekly internal delivery standup and the monthly owner project review — agenda, materials, actions, and action closure.
  • Track action items from all delivery forums to closure with named owners and dates.
  • Support lender, tax equity, and host milestone certification with defensible documentation.

Systems and Data Standards

  • Define and enforce data standards — naming conventions, site codes, equipment tags, WBS structure — so that delivery data reconciles to operations data after turnover rather than requiring a manual crosswalk.
  • Build and maintain reporting tooling and dashboards that surface exceptions rather than requiring the reader to hunt for them.
  • Automate recurring coordination tasks. Every hour automated is an hour returned to analysis.
  • Build durable tooling within the constraints of the actual environment, including SharePoint limitations, rather than solutions that depend on software SSM does not have.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Five or more years in project controls, cost engineering, or scheduling within construction, energy, or infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ownership of schedule baselines and earned value reporting on capital projects.
  • Working command of EPC contract commercial terms and their controls implications — milestone payment, retainage, liquidated damages, and change authority.
  • Advanced Excel; scheduling software proficiency (Primavera P6 or MS Project).
  • Demonstrated ability to report an unfavorable variance accurately to the person whose project it is.
  • Willingness to perform coordination and document control work personally at current scale. This role builds the function before it supervises one.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, finance, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.



Preferred Qualifications
  • Solar PV or BESS construction controls experience.
  • AACE International certification — PSP, CCP, or EVP.
  • Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, or Python for reporting automation.
  • Experience building durable tooling inside SharePoint-constrained environments.
  • Experience standing up a controls function rather than inheriting one.

.
Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $20–$35 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a marketing analyst internship that sits between the data and the decision. We generate a lot of signal across outbound, inbound, content, and the product itself, and most of it goes unread. Your job is to find the pattern in it, explain what it means in plain language, and then help act on it. The analysis is only half the role: the other half is that someone changes what they do because of what you found.

You will work close to the growth function at an early-stage company, which means the questions are open rather than assigned. Expect to spend time in spreadsheets, to have to define a metric before you can report it, and to write up what you learned so it survives past the week you learned it.

Responsibilities

  • Pull, clean, and analyze data across marketing, outbound, and product usage.
  • Identify patterns and anomalies, and explain what is causing them in plain language.
  • Build and maintain simple reporting that the team actually reads and uses.
  • Define and document metrics so numbers mean the same thing week to week.
  • Turn findings into concrete recommendations, and help implement the ones that get picked up.

Requirements

  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot patterns in data.
  • Clear written communication, including explaining an insight simply to a non-analyst.
  • Interest in marketing, growth, analytics, startups, recruiting, or AI products.
  • Organized and comfortable working across several projects at once.
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote startup environment.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who combines strong hands-on development expertise with a passion for building scalable, modern SaaS products. In this role, you will contribute to core product capabilities, influence architecture and engineering standards, and help deliver innovative AI-enabled experiences for our customers. You will work across the application stack, partnering closely with engineering, product, and UX teams to develop high-quality solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and helping teams adopt modern development practices that improve both quality and delivery velocity.

Responsibilities

  • Develop high-quality product features using modern web technologies and engineering best practices.
  • Design, build, and maintain both frontend and backend application components, APIs, and services.
  • Help define and evolve application architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards across the platform.
  • Contribute to the continued growth and evolution of a multi-tenant SaaS platform with a focus on scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Build and integrate AI-enabled features, workflows, and user experiences that provide meaningful value to customers.
  • Collaborate with technical leadership on system design, architectural decisions, and long-term platform strategy.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and engineering initiatives that improve quality, testing, automation, and delivery processes.
  • Promote modern development practices, including AI-assisted development workflows, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Mentor and support fellow engineers through technical guidance, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.
  • Partner closely with Product, UX, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver well-designed, customer-focused solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical solutions that enhance product quality, developer productivity, and customer experience.

Required Qualifications

Core Technical Strengths

  • Strong experience building modern web applications using contemporary frontend frameworks and technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern software development practices.
  • Experience designing and developing APIs and backend services.
  • Experience working with cloud-based application environments and deployment pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, software design patterns, and scalable engineering principles.
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments with source control, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.

AI-Enabled Product Development

  • Experience integrating AI services or AI-enabled capabilities into modern applications, or demonstrated ability to rapidly develop expertise in this area.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and modern AI integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, vector search, tool use, and AI orchestration.
  • Understanding of the reliability, security, privacy, governance, and user-experience considerations associated with AI-enabled applications.
  • Interest in using AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity.

Engineering Leadership & Architecture

  • Demonstrated ability to influence application architecture and engineering standards.
  • Experience designing scalable, maintainable solutions within SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, security principles, and multi-tenant application patterns.
  • Ability to balance long-term technical excellence with pragmatic business and delivery goals.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and helping elevate team-wide development practices.

Modern Web Engineering Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture and separation of concerns.
  • Experience building accessible, performant, and responsive web applications.
  • Familiarity with modern data-fetching, state management, routing, and application architecture patterns.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and consistency.
  • Familiarity with specification-driven development approaches, automation, and quality-focused engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in SaaS or multi-tenant application environments.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and modern infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience shipping AI-enabled functionality in a production SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with data-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience with design systems or reusable component libraries.
  • Exposure to AI platforms, intelligent workflows, or agent-based solutions.

What Success Looks Like

  • You help deliver reliable, scalable, and high-quality features that create meaningful customer value.
  • You contribute to architectural decisions that improve the long-term health and scalability of the platform.
  • You champion modern engineering practices that improve quality, consistency, and team effectiveness.
  • You help establish patterns and standards that enable the platform and engineering organization to grow successfully.
  • You mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
  • You build solutions that others can confidently extend and maintain.

PLEASE NOTE:

  • This role will work in the Eastern Time Zone.
  • Limited travel. Generally fewer than five trips per year for in-person team, planning, or company meetings.
  • This role is posted as remote, but it could be hybrid or in-office if that best fits your working style.
  • This role is ONLY available for work in the following (24) locations: AL, AR, CO, FL, IL, IN, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NC, NH, NJ, PA, SC, TX, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV, & DC.

If you don't meet all the requirements mentioned above, don't worry. We strongly believe in creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you find this job opportunity interesting but don't meet all the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect candidate for this role or similar roles.

Who We Are:

ROI Solutions was founded in 1999 to help nonprofit organizations change the world through innovative technology solutions and services. We are focused on sustainable growth, hiring staff committed to working with the nonprofit sector, and constantly evolving our technology and services to help nonprofits succeed in their missions with passion and purpose. This is our calling. We’re a proudly independent company, meaning we answer only to our clients rather than shareholders and investors. Our clients inspire our product and solution roadmaps, as well as our strategic direction. We’re committed to this model and the opportunity it provides us to develop our solutions based on needs in the nonprofit sector.

We are a proud equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as established by law.

Salary: $105,000-$120,000
