raw.description:
About the team

At Zillow, we believe home should be more than just a dream. The Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Product team delivers a home financing journey that gives consumers more confidence, transparency, and ease than they can find anywhere else. We partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Research, and Operations to bring holistic experience innovation to market. This team is building an AI-native operating model for service delivery — agentic systems that reason about the next best action, and durable workflow infrastructure that carries those decisions out reliably.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. AI agents reason over each customer's situation, adapt that process to the specific opportunity in front of them, and determine the next work that should happen: the action, the outcome it is meant to create, the quality bar it must meet, and the skills required to execute it. You will own that loop across engagement and loan production. You design the AI harness (context, tools, memory, orchestration, escalation, guardrails) that determines what those agents reason over and what work they produce. You own the eval infrastructure that scores those decisions against the process you defined, learns from operator feedback, and uses experiments to decide what to keep, change, or retire.

You Will Get To

  • Define and lead a multi-year product vision for Directed Workflows as an AI-first service system spanning engagement and loan production

  • Define, with Sales and Business Operations, the sales and service process this system encodes: customer jobs, value at each stage, and how that experience earns attention and advocacy

  • Design the AI harness that turns that process into AI agent behavior: context engineering, tool design, memory, orchestration, and guardrails, including where a model should reason, where deterministic systems should execute, and what requires a person. The work the agent produces names the action, intended outcome, quality bar, and skills required to execute

  • Own the eval infrastructure you build or integrate: score AI agent output against the intended process, learn from operator feedback in production, and run experiments that show whether the directed work moved the outcome

  • Sequence from high-leverage pilots to platform: prove outcomes in focused increments, retire or redesign what does not move the metrics, then expand successful patterns across the financing journey

  • Influence across Zillow so the customer experience, the real estate agent experience, and the home finance operator experience operate as one coordinated service, and represent that strategy with senior leaders including risks and trade-offs

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $178,300.00 - $284,700.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $169,300.00 - $270,500.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex systems spanning multiple teams and customer or operator journeys

  • Demonstrated experience shipping agentic or decisioning products as a closed loop: designing the AI harness and the eval infrastructure that proved and improved outcomes

  • Experience shaping sales or service strategy with business leaders, tying process design to customer jobs, value delivery, and growth

  • Strong analytical ability using data, experimentation, and model/product evaluation to improve conversion, quality, or operator productivity

  • Track record of influencing senior Engineering, AI, Operations, and business stakeholders around strategy, trade-offs, and execution

  • Or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Nice to have: mortgage or lending experience; familiarity with workflow platforms, operator surfaces, or capacity-aware routing

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the Role

Neo4j is seeking a Global Tax and Treasury Senior Manager.to build the tax and treasury function for a global, high-growth enterprise software company. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for global tax compliance and planning, cash and liquidity management, banking, debt administration, and the processes and controls needed to support Neo4j's continued international growth.

The role will partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, and external advisors across Neo4j's global operations. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment with an operator's mindset: comfortable setting strategy, working through complex cross-border matters, and executing the underlying work in a lean environment.

What You'll Do

Tax

  • Own Neo4j's global tax compliance calendar, including U.S. federal, state, and local income and franchise taxes; international corporate income taxes; sales and use taxes; and VAT/GST across the jurisdictions in which Neo4j operates
  • Manage global tax advisors and coordinate the preparation and review of income tax returns, estimated payments, extensions, tax audits, and other tax authority inquiries
  • Lead the income tax provision process under ASC 740, including deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, tax account reconciliations, and support for the annual financial statement audit
  • Own transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, and contemporaneous documentation for cross-border services, software and intellectual property arrangements, and intercompany funding
  • Manage indirect tax compliance and strategy for Neo4j's software subscriptions, cloud offerings, professional services, marketplace transactions, and channel sales, including nexus analyses, registrations, exemption documentation, and product taxability
  • Evaluate the tax implications of new products and commercial models, international expansion, legal entity changes, acquisitions, and post-acquisition integration
  • Monitor international tax developments relevant to Neo4j, including OECD Pillar Two requirements as applicable, digital services taxes, withholding and permanent establishment exposure, and evolving SaaS taxability rules
  • Build scalable, audit-ready tax processes, documentation, and internal controls, and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reduce reliance on manual processes
  • Oversee the global tax compliance requirements associated with employee equity compensation, including stock options and RSUs, and coordinate local tax withholding, payroll, reporting, and employer compliance requirements
  • Oversee tax attributes and incentives, including R&D tax credits and net operating losses, and coordinate ownership-change analyses under Section 382 with external advisors

Treasury

  • Own global cash management, including daily cash visibility and cash concentration across legal entities, bank accounts, and currencies
  • Manage banking relationships and the bank account lifecycle, including account openings and closures, signatories, administrative access, and appropriate segregation of duties
  • Administer Neo4j's debt facilities, including covenant monitoring, interest and fee calculations, lender reporting, and coordination of required deliverables with Accounting, FP&A, and Legal
  • Manage foreign exchange exposures and recommend practical risk-mitigation or hedging strategies appropriate for Neo4j's international revenue, operating costs, and intercompany balances
  • Oversee the investment of excess cash in accordance with company policy, balancing preservation of capital, liquidity, counterparty risk, and yield
  • Structure and administer intercompany funding, loans, settlements, and repatriation in partnership with Tax, Accounting, and Legal
  • Own treasury policies and controls, including dual approvals, payment and wire controls, bank portal access reviews, fraud prevention, and support for acquisition integration and financing activities

Cross-Functional

  • Partner with Accounting on the monthly close and financial reporting for cash, debt, interest, FX, intercompany balances, and income taxes, ensuring timely reconciliations and clear ownership of deliverables
  • Partner with FP&A on liquidity forecasting and with Legal on entity governance, intercompany arrangements, financings, and regulatory requirements
  • Drive systems and process improvements across NetSuite, tax applications, and banking platforms, and prepare concise reporting for finance leadership as needed

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of progressive tax experience, with meaningful exposure to treasury operations; Big 4 or national firm experience is required
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate and multi-state taxation, ASC 740, and core international tax concepts, including transfer pricing, GILTI, Subpart F, withholding taxes, and Pillar Two
  • Experience with indirect tax issues affecting enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, professional services, cloud marketplace transactions, and cross-border digital services
  • Treasury experience covering global banking, debt administration, intercompany funding, and foreign exchange exposure management
  • CPA or advanced degree in taxation preferred; CTP or relevant treasury experience is a plus
  • Experience working across multiple international legal entities within a global, high-growth software company; acquisition integration experience is a plus
  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a lean team, moving fluidly between strategy, technical analysis, process design, and hands-on execution
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience with NetSuite, tax compliance and provision tools, and global banking platforms is preferred
  • Excellent communication and project-management skills, with the ability to translate complex tax and treasury matters for finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable, well-controlled processes and maintain audit-ready documentation in a rapidly evolving environment

Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

Program Physician (0.8 FTE) – Home-Based Pulmonary Rehabilitation

Your Role...

As a Program Physician (0.8 FTE) in our Home-Based Pulmonary Rehabilitation program, you will provide physician services and clinical oversight for patients participating in Morlen Health’s virtual pulmonary rehabilitation program. You will review referrals for clinical appropriateness, conduct physician intake assessments, establish or confirm patient plans of care, and provide physician supervision and consultation throughout the rehabilitation experience.

Working closely with respiratory therapists, the Medical Director, and other members of the interdisciplinary care team, you will apply independent clinical judgment while supporting safe, effective, patient-centered care. You will also help ensure consistent clinical documentation, coordinated care delivery, and adherence to established clinical standards and protocols.

All remote positions are based in the United States, and candidates must reside within the U.S. to be eligible for consideration.

In This Role, You Will...

  • Review patient referrals and clinical information and conduct comprehensive physician intake assessments to determine appropriateness for participation in the HBPR program.
  • Establish or confirm physician-directed plans of care based on each patient’s clinical condition, rehabilitation needs, functional status, and treatment goals.
  • Apply independent clinical judgment to patient participation and changes in condition, including determining when services should continue, be modified, placed on hold, escalated, or discontinued.
  • Provide physician supervision, consultation, and clinical direction to respiratory therapists and other designated clinical team members supporting pulmonary rehabilitation services.
  • Collaborate with respiratory therapists, referring providers, specialists, and other members of the care team to coordinate care and address clinical concerns.
  • Complete accurate and timely physician documentation to support continuity of care, medical necessity, coding, billing, and other program requirements.
  • Participate in clinical case discussions, quality activities, and continuous improvement efforts, providing physician perspective on patient care, workflows, protocols, and program delivery.
  • Foster a respectful and collaborative environment through professional, constructive, and solution-oriented communication.

What You Need to Be Successful...

  • MD or DO with completion of an accredited residency program.
  • Board certified or board eligible in an appropriate medical specialty (e.g., Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Cardiology, or Pulmonology).
  • Current, active, and unrestricted medical license, with the ability to obtain and maintain additional state licensure, credentialing, privileging, and payer enrollment as needed to support assigned patient populations.
  • Clinical experience evaluating and managing patients with pulmonary disease and/or patient populations relevant to pulmonary rehabilitation.
  • Experience conducting physician assessments, developing or managing plans of care, and collaborating with interdisciplinary clinical teams.
  • Strong clinical judgment, communication, collaboration, accountability, adaptability, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with virtual care, telehealth, home-based care, digital health, remote patient care, or other technology-enabled care-delivery models.

Action1 is an autonomous patch management platform trusted by many Fortune 500 companies. Cloud-native, infinitely scalable, highly secure, and configurable in 5 minutes, it just works and is always free for the first 200 endpoints, with no functional limits. By pioneering autonomous OS and third-party application patching, Action1 helps organizations eliminate routine work, reduce ransomware and security risks, and protect the digital employee experience. It provides real-time vulnerability assessment and remediation across remote and on-site endpoints without requiring a VPN, while peer-to-peer patch distribution reduces bandwidth use on local networks.

In 2026, Action1 was recognized as the fastest-growing founder-led cybersecurity company in America on the Inc. 5000. Action1 is led by industry veterans Alex Vovk and Mike Walters, American entrepreneurs who founded Netwrix, which has grown into an industry-leading, multibillion-dollar cybersecurity company.

We are looking for a Dev Manager to lead the engineering team responsible for integrations between our product and external systems, including the Integrations Store. You will combine engineering leadership with hands-on technical expertise to deliver secure, reliable integrations that fit our customers' workflows.

What you'll do:

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, providing technical direction, mentoring, and regular feedback.
  • Own delivery outcomes within the agreed scope, provide practical estimates, and make capacity and priority tradeoffs visible.
  • Delegate ownership to engineers and, as the team grows, team leads; distinguish near-term delivery from long-term capability development. Keep the role to no more than three clearly defined focus areas, with team leads taking ownership as capacity grows.
  • Work with Product Management to define priorities, plan delivery, and translate customer needs into integration capabilities.
  • Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of integrations, including:
    - Connectors to third-party applications and services.
    - An Integrations Store for discovering and managing available integrations.
    - Data mapping, validation, and synchronization between systems.
    - Authentication, authorization, and secure credential handling.
    - Monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery from integration failures.
  • Guide technical decisions within the assigned domain from solution design through development and production rollout, coordinating cross-cutting architecture and security decisions with their designated owners.
  • Establish reusable integration patterns that handle retries, rate limits, duplicate events, and API version changes reliably.
  • Own automated pipelines for building, testing, validating, and deploying integrations.
  • Improve integration reliability, performance, and observability, and guide the team in resolving production issues.
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams and external partners to manage dependencies and compatibility.
  • Apply AI technologies where they improve integration development, testing, or support, with appropriate validation of outputs.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Experience leading software engineers and owning the delivery and operation of production systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to contribute to technical problem-solving.
  • Excellent knowledge of Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Experience building and operating AWS services in production.
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining APIs and integrations with external systems.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, data consistency, and failure recovery.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with data modeling, aggregation, and query performance.
  • Experience with secure authentication and authorization for integrations.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align engineering work with product priorities.
  • Professional working proficiency in English for leading an English-speaking team and collaborating across functions.

Nice to have:

  • Experience writing automated integration and contract tests.
  • Proficiency in SQL.
  • Experience with runtime isolation and sandboxing for sensitive execution.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, security, compliance, or data governance.
  • Experience building high-load products with numerous endpoints.
  • Experience maintaining integrations across multiple third-party API versions.

Benefits

  • A collaborative environment that empowers you to own your domain and implement best practices.

raw.title: 2014 Senior Embedded Software Engineer - Test OS
raw.excerpt: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (SP1 - RVT): ¿Qué es?
raw.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer (SP1 - RVT):

¿Qué es?

Es un profesional especializado en el desarrollo, integración y adaptación de sistemas operativos embebidos (como Embedded Linux o RTOS) para ECUs (Unidades de Control Electrónico), con enfoque en la replicación y optimización de un Test OS en plataformas automotrices.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.

Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.

Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.

Automatiza pruebas (SIL, HIL y a nivel vehicular) para validar el comportamiento de las ECUs y los componentes conectados.

Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.

¿Por qué es crucial?

Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).

Requirements

Habilidades:

Lenguajes: C (avanzado +5 años), C++ (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), Python (intermedio 2-5 años), Bash (intermedio 2-5 años).

Sistemas operativos embebidos: Embedded Linux (avanzado +5 años), RTOS (avanzado +5 años).

Protocolos de comunicación: CAN, CAN FD, UDS (avanzado +5 años), DoIP, Automotive Ethernet (intermedio 2-5 años).

Herramientas: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape (avanzado +5 años), GDB, JTAG (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).

Pruebas automatizadas: GoogleTest, pytest (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), SIL, HIL (avanzado +5 años).

CI/CD y control de versiones: Git (avanzado +5 años), Jenkins, GitLab CI (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).

Firmware para ECUs: Integración, flasheo, diagnósticos (DIDs, DTCs) (avanzado +5 años).

Estándares: ASPICE, MISRA C (avanzado +5 años).

Visa (Obligatorio) - Viajaran a USA por el equipo de cliente

Actividades del puesto:

Análisis y adaptación del Test OS:

Analizar la arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue del Test OS implementado en vehículos Gen2.

Portar el Test OS a las ECUs Gen1 de RVT, asegurando compatibilidad con el hardware existente.

Desarrollo de software embebido:

Desarrollar capas de abstracción de plataforma para facilitar la comunicación, control y monitoreo de las ECUs.

Implementar módulos de software para integración de diagnósticos, flasheo de firmware y adquisición de datos.

Integración de funcionalidades clave:

Integrar diagnósticos de ECU (DIDs, DTCs) usando protocolos como UDS y DoIP.

Implementar rutinas de flasheo de firmware para actualizaciones seguras en las ECUs.

Configurar sistemas de logging y monitoreo de salud para registrar y analizar datos en tiempo real.

Automatización de pruebas:

Diseñar y desarrollar pruebas SIL (Software-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en entornos simulados.

Crear pruebas HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en conjunto con hardware real.

Implementar pruebas a nivel vehicular para validar el comportamiento del sistema en condiciones reales.

Depuración y resolución de problemas:

Depurar problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) en las ECUs.

Colaborar con equipos de ECU, eléctrica, sistemas, validación y hardware para identificar y resolver brechas de plataforma.

Colaboración y documentación:

Trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios para asegurar la integración y validación del Test OS en Gen1.

Documentar procesos, cambios y resultados de las pruebas y adaptaciones realizadas.

Cumplimiento de estándares:

Asegurar que el desarrollo del software cumpla con estándares como ASPICE y MISRA C.

Validar que las soluciones implementadas cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y calidad del cliente.

Fontaine Modification Company

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Fontaine Modification focuses on the design and manufacturing of innovative solutions for heavy truck manufacturers, dealers, and commercial truck users worldwide. We fill the niche between what OEM truck chassis builders can produce in their manufacturing plants and what the market needs for a wide variety of fleet and vocational truck applications.

Fontaine’s long history of providing innovative and custom-engineered solutions in an environment of integrity, customer responsiveness, quality products, and superior workmanship has made us a recognized leader in the industry.

Fontaine Modification is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Vocational Sales Manager to drive new business growth and strengthen key relationships across our body company, dealer, OEM, equipment provider, and end-customer networks. Serving as the strategic "face to the customer," this role is pivotal in identifying client pain points, translating operational needs into value-added solutions, and delivering best-in-class service to secure long-term partnerships.

The Vocational Sales Manager will actively manage account pipelines, execute strategic pricing and growth plans, and collaborate closely with internal engineering, operations, and business unit leadership to ensure accurate, profitable deliverables. Additionally, this role gathers critical market intelligence and Voice of the Customer insights—representing Fontaine at industry trade shows and events—to shape future business strategies and maintain our position as an industry leader.

This is a full-time, remote position with up to 50% travel required to engage key accounts and represent Fontaine at industry events.

To Apply

Please respond with a cover letter and resume. Your cover letter should describe your background and relevant experience. It should also include three clearly defined reasons why you should be considered for this position.

Fontaine Modification Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE/AA: M/F/Vets/Disabled).

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to , and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

Annotation is what helps AI make sense of the world. As an annotator, you may be invited to take part in online projects such as rating AI-generated content, evaluating factual accuracy, or comparing responses — when projects are available.

While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Carefully review provided data (text, images, or videos);
  • Label or classify content based on project guidelines;
  • Identify and flag factually incorrect, sensitive, inappropriate, or unclear material.

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for candidates open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline;
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in any professional role;
  • Logical thinking, fact-checking and reasoning abilities;
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to understand and follow complex instructions;
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions when needed;
  • Genuine interest in technology and artificial intelligence;
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1+).

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project (when available) → Complete tasks → Get paid

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments;
  • Participate into advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio;
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $19/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate. Keep in mind, quality standards must be maintained, regardless of speed.

Job Title: Claims Examiner – Life, Accident, Critical Illness, LTC, and Hospital Indemnity

Overview: As a Claims Analyst specializing in Accident, Critical Illness, Short-Term Disability, and Hospital Indemnity lines of business, you will be responsible for accurately assessing and processing claims related to these insurance products. Your role will involve investigating claims, verifying policy coverage, determining liability, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and empathy are essential for this position as you will interact with claimants, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely and fair claim settlements.

Key Responsibilities:

Claims Processing and Assessment:

  • Evaluate incoming claims to determine eligibility, coverage, and validity.
  • Conduct thorough investigations, including reviewing medical records and other relevant documentation.
  • Analyze policy provisions and contractual agreements to assess claim validity.
  • Utilize claims management systems to document findings and process claims efficiently.

Communication and Customer Service:

  • Communicate effectively with policyholders, beneficiaries, and healthcare providers regarding claim status and requirements.
  • Provide timely responses to inquiries and maintain professional and empathetic communication throughout the claims process.
  • Address customer concerns and escalate complex issues to senior claims personnel or management as needed.

Compliance and Documentation:

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation related to claims activities.
  • Follow established guidelines for claims adjudication and payment authorization.

Quality Assurance and Improvement:

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency within the claims department.
  • Participate in quality assurance initiatives to uphold service standards and improve claim handling practices.
  • Collaborate with team members and management to implement best practices and enhance overall departmental performance.

Reporting and Analysis:

  • Generate reports and provide data analysis on claims trends, processing times, and outcomes.
  • Contribute to the development of management reports and presentations regarding claims operations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, insurance, healthcare management, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Prior experience in claims processing, preferably in Accident, Critical Illness, LTC, and/or Hospital Indemnity insurance.
  • Knowledge of insurance principles, policies, and practices related to accident, critical illness, LTC, and hospital indemnity lines of business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex documents and policies.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a customer-focused approach.
  • Proficiency in using claims management software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

Preferred Skills:

  • ACS and/or ALHC Designation
  • Experience with medical terminology and healthcare billing practices.
  • Understanding of regulatory requirements governing claims processing in the insurance industry.

Attributes:

  • Demonstrated strong punctuality and attendance practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and thoroughness.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently when necessary.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
  • Adaptable to changing priorities and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment:

  • Remote work environment role with regular business hours (9:00am – 6:00pm Eastern).
  • Occasional overtime or weekend work may be required during peak periods or to meet deadlines.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within the claims department or broader insurance organization.
The candidate must possess a curiosity and willingness to actively adopt and leverage emerging AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and drive efficiency along with being comfortable using a range of AI-enabled tools (such as copilots, chat-based AI, and automation solutions) as part of everyday work

Hourly Rate - $21.00

Liderar a implantação e evolução da operação de CRM via WhatsApp, integrando Dito + Omnichat + operação das lojas, garantindo implementação tecnológica, desenho dos processos, adoção pelas equipes e geração de resultado comercial.

O PO será o dono do projeto de ponta a ponta, do piloto à escala.

  1. Gestão do projeto e cronograma
    • Construir e acompanhar cronograma, marcos, responsáveis e dependências.
    • Gerenciar backlog, riscos, prioridades e critérios de go/no go.
    • Coordenar CRM, TI, BI, Varejo, Dito e Omnichat.
  2. Implantação e integrações
    • Acompanhar integrações sistêmicas e requisitos funcionais.
    • Preparar ambiente de testes, homologação e produção.
    • Coordenar testes de fluxos, filas, disparos, dados e mensuração.
    • Garantir preparação tecnológica das lojas piloto.
  3. Desenho da operação
    • Construir os fluxos de atendimento, encarteiramento, campanhas, distribuição e transferência de clientes.
    • Definir políticas de gestão de filas, capacidade e SLAs de atendimento.
    • Desenhar jornada de chatbot e regras de transbordo para atendimento humano.
    • Estruturar regras de utilização: o que pode, o que não pode e quais são as exceções.
  4. Papéis e governança
    • Construir matriz clara de responsabilidades entre PO, CRM, TI, gerentes e vendedores.
    • Definir rituais de gestão e acompanhamento da operação.
    • Realizar pautas semanais com lojas e áreas envolvidas para identificar problemas e oportunidades.
  5. Treinamento e adoção
    • Construir materiais, processos e treinamento para gerentes e vendedores.
    • Acompanhar utilização da ferramenta e aderência aos processos.
    • Atuar sobre dificuldades de adoção e necessidades de evolução.
  6. Performance e mensuração
    • Criar relatório diário de acompanhamento da operação.
    • Estruturar comparação entre lojas piloto x lojas controle.
    • Acompanhar volumetria de contatos, clientes ativos, produtividade, conversão e receita.
    • Construir matriz de resultado financeiro e mensurar receita incremental do projeto.
  7. Gestão financeira e escala
    • Gerenciar orçamento do piloto.
    • Projetar custos de plataforma, mensageria, usuários e infraestrutura para expansão.
    • Construir business case e ROI para decisão de escala.
  8. Evolução do produto
    • Identificar oportunidades a partir dos aprendizados do piloto.
    • Priorizar novas jornadas, automações, regras e integrações.
    • Manter roadmap evolutivo da solução.
    • Recomendar escalar, ajustar ou interromper cada iniciativa com base nos resultados.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência em Product Ownership e/ou Gestão de Projetos, com atuação em projetos de implantação de tecnologia e criação de processos e fluxos de trabalho.
  • Domínio de gestão de projetos, incluindo cronogramas, backlog, matriz RACI, riscos, dependências, prioridades e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Experiência em discovery, levantamento de requisitos e desenho de processos/jornadas, conectando necessidades do negócio às soluções técnicas.
  • Capacidade de orquestrar projetos multidisciplinares, envolvendo áreas de negócio, Tecnologia,CRM, Dados, Varejo e fornecedores externos.
  • Experiência com implantação, treinamento e gestão da mudança, garantindo adoção de novos processos e ferramentas pelos usuários.
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets e PowerPoint, com capacidade para construção de controles, análises, reports e apresentações executivas.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores, orçamento e business cases, incluindo acompanhamento de custos, performance e análise de ROI.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
Diferenciais
Experiência com operações de varejo físico, CRM, WhatsApp Business/API, atendimento omnichannel ou projetos envolvendo equipes de lojas será considerada um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Principais entregáveis:

Cronograma e roadmap | Fluxos operacionais | Matriz de responsabilidades | Políticas de atendimento e filas | Jornada do chatbot | Plano de treinamento | Dashboard diário | Piloto x controle | Matriz financeira/ROI | Business case de expansão | Backlog de evoluções.

If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a remote/work-from-home (WFH) production underwriting role that includes travel to key agency relationships within the assigned territory.

Territory: TBD but likely a combination of states in the overall Northeast.

Preferably, this individual will be based in or close to their respective territory.

Qualified candidates must have Commercial insurance underwriting experience (with authority) and a profitability & production orientated lens along with agency management.

Additionally:

  • Strong preference for commercial middle market expertise

  • Construction-specific insurance industry experience is ideal

  • Existing relationships with agency partner firms is highly desirable

The internal title for this role is Territory Manager, Construction Services Business Development - Commercial Lines.

This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.

Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Construction Services Territory Manager, you'll market, manage and underwrite commercial line business through direct contact with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through developing, negotiating and executing business plans. Collaboration with all internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence will be key to success.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and other factors necessary to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes plans to resolve those situations.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Reviews for acceptability and handles those within authority, aligned with underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work using company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with others to meet service level agreements.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, accountabilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the team on new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all products that may improve offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer and business development in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win business.

  • Consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique business. Provides industry trend observations to leadership. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability.

  • Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates and collaborates actively with team and leaders to share market intelligence, industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, and improve agency relationship. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority.

  • Proven ability to manage a significant workload effectively and back up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Manager or Director.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial line business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

raw.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

  • Work closely with individual agents in order to generate new commercial lines business opportunities.

Develops and implements agency action plans to meet financial and strategic goals and any corrective actions as needed. May include training, re-underwriting, rehabilitation programs, mergers or agency termination. Works closely with underwriting to implement corrective actions with agents as needed.

  • Strong commercial lines insurance experience and knowledge preferred
  • Ability to work independently and highly motivated
  • Continuing education and insurance designations highly preferred

The base pay is just one component of Donegal's total compensation package for employees. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

Competitive Benefits Package

Donegal Insurance Group provides commercial and personal insurance products through a network of independent agents in 21 states and across several regions of the U.S. In Texas, Colorado, Utah, New Mexico and Arizona, business is conducted under the Mountain States Insurance Group name; and in Michigan, business is conducted under the Michigan Insurance name.

Job Overview:

The AVP, Senior Trustee Consultant will be an integral member of the Business Development team within LPL’s wholly owned subsidiary The Private Trust Company. Our innovative, entrepreneurial, high-performing team helps independent advisors and RIAs by providing trustee services to their clients. Through our delegated model The Private Trust Company enables LPL Advisors to maintain investment management and relationship management responsibilities.

We are looking for an experienced and engaging trust professional who is passionate about helping LPL Advisors provide trustee services to their clients, including High Net Worth and Ultra High Net Worth relationships. This role is responsible for delivering an exceptional experience while supporting LPL Advisor inquiries and advancing new trustee opportunities through our acceptance process and into onboarding. This role will be a key contributor to LPL advisor satisfaction and PTC's ability to generate repeat business.

Responsibilities:

  • Trustee Case Consultant: Serve as the lead consultant with LPL Advisors when they present new cases to PTC for trustee and/or settlement services. Exhibit thorough knowledge of both trust administration and settlement services. Analyze and interpret relevant legal documents and asset statements. Including wills, trusts, agreements, entity documents, investment statements, and special asset information in relation to the clients’ trust(s) and/or estate. Summarize and prepare new cases for legal and acceptance reviews. Including, mentoring and coaching trust specialists to assist you in preparing summaries, document management and communication with advisors, trustees, attorneys and beneficiaries.
  • Relationship Management and Client Service: Manage financial advisor and client experience while providing service and support for moderately complex to complex trustee cases. Identify client needs, address client concerns, resolve issues (with guidance from senior officers where appropriate) and respond to client inquiries while keeping relevant parties involved. Effectively communicate with financial advisors, external partners and colleagues throughout all steps of PTC’s trustee acceptance process.
  • Project Management: Superior organizational and follow up skills to ensure the new business opportunity pipeline is managed both efficiently and diligently. Participate in special projects and initiatives, create effective working relationships with colleagues and peers within PTC and across LPL. Collaborate with colleagues and associates to enhance best practices, engage appropriate resources and foster strong team dynamics.
  • PTC Brand Ambassador: Represent PTC in business development efforts with internal partners at LPL and with LPL Advisors.

Other Duties:

  • Participating in LPL advisor and client meetings as needed
  • Preparation of special reports, spreadsheets and correspondence, as needed

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Five years’ experience in trustee services, preferably with a broker-dealer or in a traditional bank/trust company. Knowledge of financial planning, philanthropic planning and fiduciary law.
  • Experience working with high net worth (HNW) clients
  • Will have a proven ability to successfully handle multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines in a quality-first, team-oriented environment
  • Strong use of Microsoft Office

Core Competencies:

  • Verbal and written communication skills for effective interactions with clients, financial advisors, and other professionals

Preferences:

  • CTFA, CFP or ChFC

Pay Range:

$88,580.00 - $147,599.00Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.


At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.


For further information about LPL, please visit .


Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an @lplfinancial.com email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. raw.excerpt: Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well.
raw.description:
Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

About The Role

Facet is seeking an experienced Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to step into a high-touch, member-facing role as a Senior Tax Associate. If you love the strategic advisory side of public accounting or private wealth management—but dread tax season, compliance filings, and timesheets—this is the ideal next step in your career.

In this consultative position, you will be on the frontline, leading weekly virtual tax strategy sessions directly with Facet members. You will translate complex tax laws into actionable, high-impact strategies without ever filing a tax return. Partnering closely with our CFP® Lead Planners, you will apply Facet’s modern tax planning framework to empower members to make confident, tax-optimized life decisions.

Key Highlights:

  • No Tax Return Preparation or Compliance: 100% focused on forward-looking planning, education, and member advisory.
  • Direct Member Impact: High-cadence consultation environment leading 10–15 video strategy sessions per week.
  • Modern Wealth Management: Operate as the subject matter expert within a modern, tech-enabled RIA structure.
  • Balanced Work Load: NO BUSY SEASON!

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Direct Member Consultations: Lead 10–15 virtual strategy sessions per week, delivering tailored tax advice, answering complex real-time questions, and guiding members through high-stakes financial decisions.
  • Continuous Member Engagement: Serve as the primary tax sounding board for members by delivering clear, plain-English answers to day-to-day inbound questions via our secure messaging platform (covering withholdings, life events, IRS notices, and tax projections).
  • Proactive Tax Plan Diagnostic: Review member tax returns (Form 1040s and schedules) to diagnose multi-year optimization opportunities, including Roth conversions, equity vesting events, real estate transactions, and executive compensation.
  • Custom Modeling & Scenario Analysis: Build, model, and present customized tax strategies using modern planning tools—focusing on bracket management, withholding adjustments, and estimated tax schedules.
  • Technical Research & Analysis: Perform deep-dive research into complex federal and multi-state tax scenarios to architect compliant, creative strategies across diverse household profiles.
  • Planner Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our Lead Planners and Director of Specialized Advice to integrate tax optimization seamlessly into overall holistic financial plans.

Commonly Advised Strategies & Domains

  • Roth Conversion & Income Optimization: Evaluating income streams for multi-year Roth conversion strategies while managing downstream impacts on IRMAA brackets, ACA subsidies, and Social Security taxation.
  • Real Estate & Rental Assets: Advising on cost recovery, depreciation, Passive Activity Loss (PAL) rules, short-term rental strategies, and Section 1031 exchanges.
  • Charitable Giving Strategies: Structuring high-impact options, including Donor-Advised Funds (DAFs), Qualified Charitable Distributions (QCDs), and appreciated stock gifting.
  • Small Business & Entity Structuring: Advising business owners on entity selection (Sole Prop, S-Corp, LLC), Section 199A QBI optimization, pass-through taxation, and exit planning.
  • Equity Compensation: Navigating tax impacts of ISOs, NSOs, RSUs, and ESPPs, including Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) strategies and liquidity event planning.

Requirements

  • Active Credential:Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license required.
  • Relevant Experience: 5–7+ years of professional experience specializing in personal tax planning, private client tax advisory, high-net-worth tax consulting, or wealth management.
  • Member-Facing Excellence: Demonstrated history of managing a regular client meeting cadence (e.g., 10–15 client consultations weekly) with exceptional empathy, active listening, and strong presentation skills over video.
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Expert ability to analyze Form 1040s and supporting schedules rapidly to spot tax inefficiencies, missed opportunities, and exposure risks.
  • Deep Technical Knowledge: Strong expertise in individual federal and state tax codes, pass-through entities, retirement distribution strategies, and executive compensation planning.
  • Fiduciary Ethos: Uncompromising integrity and a dedication to delivering objective, member-first advice.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation or active pursuit of the credential.
    • Prior experience delivering advisory services within a fee-only RIA, multi-family office, or wealth management firm alongside CFP® professionals.
    • High proficiency with modern tax modeling tools (Holistiplan, BNA, Corvee) and CRM/digital workflow tools.

Benefits

  • $110,000 – $150,000 base salary: Determined by experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Equity (ISO): It is important to us that all employees are shareholders in our mission.
  • Flexible PTO
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, short/long-term disability (paid by Facet), life insurance, and paid parental leave.
  • Certification and wellness reimbursement programs
  • Work from anywhere in the US

*Facet was ranked #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY in April 2025 who partnered with Statista to rank the top 500 RIAs. Recommendations were collected via an independent survey among over 30,000 individuals. Self-recommendations were prohibited, and no compensation was provided for the ranking. raw.title: Mobile Application Business Analyst (Employed or freelance)
raw.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésVous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux.
raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux. Dans le cadre de la refonte complète d’une application mobile, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins métier en éléments fonctionnels clairs, cohérents et exploitables par les équipes UX/UI et de développement.

Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de définition fonctionnelle jusqu’à la préparation du développement, avec une attention particulière portée à la cohérence entre parcours utilisateurs, écrans, backlog et critères d’acceptation.

Description de mission

Le rôle consiste à faire le lien entre :

  • les besoins métier,
  • l’expérience utilisateur (UX),
  • les équipes design,
  • les équipes de développement,
  • l’architecture,
  • la QA et la gestion de projet.

Vous êtes garant de la structuration des parcours utilisateurs, de la transformation des besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et de la traçabilité entre les différentes étapes de conception et de delivery.

Responsabilités principales

1. Analyse métier et cadrage fonctionnel

  • Recueillir les besoins métier et utilisateurs.
  • Challenge les demandes afin d’en clarifier les objectifs réels.
  • Structurer les User Journeys et formaliser les parcours détaillés.
  • Identifier les pain points, les cas complexes et les dépendances.
  • Prioriser les besoins avec les parties prenantes du projet.

2. Structuration des parcours utilisateurs

  • Définir les parcours de bout en bout.
  • Décomposer chaque parcours en étapes détaillées.
  • Prendre en compte les variantes, exceptions, cas d’erreur, scénarios offline, dépendances temps réel et besoins d’accessibilité (PMR).
  • Garantir une couverture complète des scénarios critiques et des edge cases.

3. Transformation des besoins en éléments exploitables

Vous structurez et maintenez la traçabilité complète entre :

User Journey → Features → Screens → User Stories → Acceptance Criteria

  • Transformer les besoins métier en fonctionnalités détaillées.
  • Réaliser le screen mapping et contribuer au screen inventory.
  • Formaliser des wireflows fonctionnels clairs.
  • Veiller à l’exhaustivité des écrans et à la cohérence des comportements attendus.

4. Préparation du travail UX/UI

  • Préparer les éléments nécessaires au travail des designers.
  • Définir le maillage des écrans et les comportements fonctionnels.
  • Documenter les différents états : loading, error, empty, offline et edge cases.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les UX/UI Designers pour assurer la cohérence des parcours.

5. Gestion et structuration du backlog

  • Rédiger les Epics et les User Stories.
  • Définir des Acceptance Criteria précis et exploitables.
  • Structurer les dépendances et préparer les refinements.
  • Maintenir un backlog complexe clair, priorisé et actionnable dans un cadre Agile / Scrum.

6. Coordination avec les équipes de delivery

  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques afin de clarifier les comportements attendus.
  • Participer aux ateliers UX/UI et aux refinements Agile.
  • Apporter un support aux équipes QA/UAT.
  • Faciliter l’alignement entre les besoins métier, la conception et l’implémentation.

7. Documentation et gouvernance fonctionnelle

  • Maintenir la documentation fonctionnelle dans Confluence.
  • Utiliser des outils de modélisation tels que Draw.io lorsque pertinent.
  • Structurer les référentiels fonctionnels avec rigueur.
  • Garantir la cohérence documentaire et la traçabilité entre besoins, parcours, écrans, stories et tests.
  • Assurer une rédaction fonctionnelle de haut niveau, adaptée à des projets mobiles complexes.

Livrables attendus

  • User Journeys détaillés
  • Mapping fonctionnel
  • Screen Inventory
  • Wireflows fonctionnels
  • Epics
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Documentation Confluence
  • Support aux scénarios UAT
  • Matrices de traçabilité

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Senior Business Analyst, idéalement dans des environnements digitaux et sur des projets mobiles complexes.

Compétences essentielles :

  • Business Analysis digitale
  • Structuration de backlogs complexes
  • Rédaction fonctionnelle
  • User Journeys
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Screen Mapping
  • Wireflows
  • Gestion des edge cases et des scénarios critiques
  • Méthodologies Agile / Scrum
  • Confluence
  • Draw.io

Soft skills recherchés :

  • Excellente capacité de structuration et grande rigueur documentaire
  • Très bonne communication avec des interlocuteurs variés
  • Esprit analytique et vision systémique
  • Capacité à travailler dans des environnements transverses et à faciliter des ateliers
  • Approche pragmatique, orientée solution, utilisateur et delivery

Langues :

  • Néerlandais ou français
  • Anglais

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Lead the next phase of the healthcare data platform modernization
  • Implement the evolution from a Microsoft SQL eXtensible Markup Language (MSSQL XML) object store toward a scalable, cloud-native AWS data architecture that enables business stakeholders and analysts to run performant, SQL-based reports and queries against healthcare data seamlessly
  • Evaluate and decide the right AWS data strategy for the platform
  • Evaluate and recommend the optimal AWS-native data storage and query architecture for the XML object store data, assessing options such as S3 + Athena, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redshift, and OpenSearch based on query patterns, reporting needs, cost, and scalability
  • Design and build the reporting and query layer that allows business stakeholders and non-technical users to run relational SQL queries against healthcare data using familiar tooling
  • Architect the migration path for XML object store data from MSSQL into the target AWS platform, defining storage formats, partitioning strategies, and data organization for optimal query performance
  • Build and maintain AWS data catalog, schemas, and metadata management so that object store data is discoverable and queryable by business users
  • Optimize query performance and cost across chose AWS services – partitioning, compression, file formats, and query pattern tuning
  • Work directly with business stakeholders and analysts to understand reporting requirements and translate them into durable, performant data models and query patterns
  • Collaborate with back-end C#/.Net engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) processing pipelines into the new data layer
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure using AWS-native tooling (CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy)
  • Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), CloudFormation, or Terraform
  • Document architecture decisions, data flows, and data dictionaries clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
Required Skills and Experience
  • 8+ years’ experience in software or data engineering with a strong AWS focus
  • Proven experience architecting and executing cloud data platform migrations in production enterprise or healthcare environments
  • Track record of evaluating and selecting AWS data services to meet business reporting and query requirements
  • Experience delivering reporting or analytics solutions that serve non-technical business users
  • Deep hands-on AWS experience across data-oriented services – S3, Athena, Glue, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redshift, OpenSearch, Lambda, IAM, and Cloudwatch
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to design relational query layers over semi-structured or non-relational data (XML, JSON)
  • Experience working with XML-heavy data stores – parsing, querying, and transforming XML at scale
  • An ability to evaluate trade-offs across AWS data services and make architecture recommendations based on cost, performance, and business requirements
  • Familiarity with AWS analytics and reporting services, including Athena, QuickSight, RedShift, or equivalent Business Intelligence (BI) tooling
  • Proficiency with Git and GitHub - branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative workflows
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and AWS-native tooling (CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy)
  • IaC experience (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform)
  • Strong ability to communicate technical architecture decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience gathering and translating business reporting requirements into technical data models
  • Comfort driving ambiguous architecture decisions to resolutions with limited direction
  • Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and JIRA
  • Strong documentation habits – architecture diagrams, data dictionaries, migration runbooks
Professional CertificationsNone but AWS certifications are a bonusYears of Professional Experiencen/aDesired experienceElectronic Data Interchange X.12 (EDI) Medical Claims
  • X.12, Medical Claims (837, 835, 277CA, etc), Health Level (HL7), Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)
Familiarity with C#/.Net back-end services for integration touchpoints
Experience with Entity Framework migration or deprecation projects
Experience with healthcare payer/Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) systems, clearinghouses, or pharmacy operations
Knowledge of HIPAA compliance requirements in cloud data architectureFormal EducationBachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience consideredCitizenship RequirementU.S. Citizenship required for this specific opportunitySecurity Clearance RequirementsMust possess or qualify for a Public Trust (MBI)CRITICAL NOTES:
  1. SSG will not make assumptions regarding your qualifications. Your answers to the mandatory screening questions must be supported by the information on your resume. Applications with inconsistencies will not be considered.
  2. Recruiters or Third parties will not be considered.
  3. This is a 100% U.S. based remote position. However, candidates from CA, CO, IL, MN, NJ, NY, OR, or WA will not be considered.
  4. This is a W-2 position
  5. All interviews will be conducted on Microsoft Teams with your camera on; there will be no exceptions
  6. As part of our screening process, you will be requested to provide a link to your LinkedIn profile

U.S Citizenship is required for this specific opportunity. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information and be able to obtain a government-granted security clearance. Individuals may also be subject to a background investigation including, but not limited to criminal history, employment and education verification, drug testing, and creditworthiness.

Syms Strategic Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or genetic information.
