raw.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: About AppFollowAppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers.
raw.description:
About AppFollow

    AppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers. Support teams use it to handle reviews at scale, product teams turn user feedback into insights, and marketing and ASO teams grow app store visibility. We're a B2B SaaS company serving SMB, mid-market and enterprise clients, with a remote team based mostly in Europe.

Role overview

    We're hiring our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager. You'll own how AppFollow's products are positioned, launched and explained, both to the market and inside the company.

    You report to the CEO and work with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success teams, each needing something different from you. Product needs you to understand new features early, turn them into a clear market story and bring back what customers say about them. Marketing needs one person who knows the product inside out and produces the source of truth for campaigns, webinars and landing pages. Sales and Customer Success need positioning against competitors, a current deck and proof they can use in a demo.

    This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. There's nobody to delegate to, and most of the workflows described below don't exist yet. You'll build them.

Key responsibilities

    Positioning and messaging. Own who we're for, what we do better than competitors, and how that shows up in our messaging. You run this work with the leadership team and carry the result onto the website's product pages and everywhere else the product is described.

    Product launches. Lead every feature launch from the marketing side, from the start of development rather than the week before release. Understand the use cases with the product manager, define the message, build the launch plan and run the campaign to prospects and existing accounts together with Sales. Then measure it: opportunities created, accounts activated.

    Product feedback loop. Join sales and CS calls during betas and launches. Aggregate what prospects and customers say about a new feature (Fathom, AI tooling, your own system), define the questions the sales team should be asking, and feed the findings back to Product and Marketing: what's not landing, what needs to change in messaging or on landing pages, which use cases we're missing.

    Case studies and proof. Own the customer story pipeline: first use cases after each launch, case studies, testimonials. If a key use case has no proof yet, go get it.

    Internal source of truth. For every product and feature, keep a current, plain-language description of what it does, who it's for, why it beats the alternatives, proof points and customer quotes (we use Guru). Marketing, Sales, CS and Growth all work from it. This is not technical documentation.

    Sales and CS materials. Own the master sales deck as a modular set of approved slides and review it with the Head of Sales roughly every quarter. Help Sales find the "wow moment" for demos of new features. Translate features into business outcomes. Sales training and one-off pitch preparation stay with the Head of Sales.

    Cross-sell and upsell. Run announcement campaigns to existing and free accounts around new features and products, and coordinate with Growth on in-product channels.

How we measure success

  • Feature adoption after launch (accounts using a new feature or add-on)

  • Case studies published and launch materials ready on launch day (source of truth, deck, landing page copy)

  • Qualified pipeline (MQLs/SQLs) from product launches and launch campaigns

  • Cross-sell and upsell opportunities from campaigns to the existing base

Who we're looking for

    Experience. 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, most of it in startups where you did the work yourself. You've launched products, owned positioning and worked side by side with sales. Experience in mobile apps, ASO or gaming is a strong plus, as is knowing how both product-led and sales-led motions work.

    Way of working. Proactive. You pick up what's broken without waiting for a launch date or a request from Sales, and you're comfortable saying "this is what we're not doing."

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Client Success Team:

The Client Success team at Affirm is focused on building and growing long-term partnerships with our merchant partners, helping them maximize the value of their relationship with Affirm while driving mutual business growth. As the primary post-sale point of contact, the team works closely with merchants to optimize performance, increase product adoption, identify revenue and GMV expansion opportunities, and ensure overall account health. Client Success also serves as a strategic bridge across Analytics, Product, Marketing, Credit, and Technical teams, advocating for merchants and helping shape solutions that drive successful outcomes for both our partners and Affirm.

As a Client Success (CS) Lead, you will work with our existing merchants to drive revenue and GMV expansion. The CS Lead position is a high-profile, merchant-facing role requiring outstanding relationship management and program management skills to guide merchants successfully from deployment to optimization. The CS Lead acts as the central post-sale contact for Affirm merchant partners. This person will report to the Senior Manager, Client Success.

What You'll Do:

  • You will manage a portfolio of accounts across a variety of industries to foster long-term, strategic business relationships with our merchant partners.
  • You will be responsible for managing contract renewals, updating pricing, and expansions.
  • You will deliver a proactive client management strategy to drive incremental gross merchandise value (“GMV”) along with revenue, and expand Affirm’s relationship coverage.
  • You will analyze merchant performance and recommend programs to increase product adoption, promote marketing best practices, and optimize program financing programs
  • You will manage merchant relationship health to ensure that both Affirm and the merchant are gaining the maximum value from the relationship
  • You will orchestrate cross-functional teams across our Analytics, Credit, Technical, Marketing, and Product teams to improve the Affirm offering for our merchant.

What We Look For:

  • 5+ years of B2B client-facing experience; preferably in a high-tech environment
  • Experience negotiating and closing commercial contracts (e.g., RFPs, renewals)
  • Excellent customer relationship management skills with the ability to manage strategic accounts
  • Experience in managing cross-functional projects with a high attention to detail
  • Strong written (e.g. proposals, memos, e-mails) and verbal communication (e.g. presenting) skills
  • Excellent analytical abilities to review merchant performance and report on the impact of specific programs to internal and external stakeholders.

POSITION SUMMARY: With general direction, utilizing an understanding of accounting principles, the Area Accountant performs accounting activities to record, analyze and monitor financial information. The incumbent prepares financial reports in a manner that ensures accuracy and compliance with company accounting policies. The Area Accountant may act as a resource for accounting and general administrative staff and is responsible for a broad array of accounting duties.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compiles and analyzes financial information to prepare journal entries and document business transactions. Prepares monthly and quarterly operational performance reports. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

  • Assists the Area Controller in ensuring there are proper internal controls in place including compliance with company policies and procedures, Sarbanes Oxley and all other statutory requirements. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

  • Reconciles balance sheet accounts and statistical data and fully analyses financial statements in accordance with the Generally Accepted Accounting Principals (GAAP) and Company policy.

  • May assist the Area Controller in the management of accounting personnel. May provide direction to the different accounting functional areas (invoice processing, billing, cash receipts, work order processing, credit analysis, receivable collections, month-end close, journal entries, statistical data, and payroll).

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Sr. Actuarial Consultant – Life Insurance Valuation REMOTE

Build your expertise in life insurance valuation

Join our Life Insurance Valuation team as a Sr. Actuarial Consultant and apply your actuarial knowledge to our life insurance products. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to accurate, efficient, and compliant valuation processes while developing expertise in evolving regulatory standards, actuarial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.

You’ll work with experienced actuaries and cross-functional partners in Tax, Controllership, Pricing, and other business areas. Your contributions will help support monthly and quarterly valuation activities, strengthen processes, and advance the team’s modernized analytical environment.

What you’ll do

  • Apply actuarial knowledge to life insurance valuation activities for life products.

  • Support the implementation and analysis of evolving standards, including Long-Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) and Principle-Based Reserving (PBR).

  • Prepare, analyze, and explain results for assigned monthly and quarterly valuation deliverables.

  • Develop and enhance tools used to validate and analyze valuation results.

  • Collaborate with Tax, Controllership, Pricing, and other stakeholders to support business objectives.

  • Follow established process controls, documentation, and governance requirements.

  • Assist with responses to auditor and regulator inquiries by providing accurate, well-supported analysis.

  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives involving actuarial data, modeling, assumptions, product development, analytics, and reporting.

  • Identify opportunities to improve valuation processes, tools, and reporting.

What you’ll bring

  • ASA is required and work towards or achievement of the Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) preferred.

  • Knowledge of actuarial business functions and life insurance valuation principles.

  • Experience with life insurance products and Statutory or GAAP valuation preferred.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and analytical tools such as SQL, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Exposure to actuarial modeling software such as AXIS, ALFA, or PolySystems preferred.

  • Programming experience in Python or VB.NET is a plus.

  • Ability to learn quickly, manage assigned priorities, and communicate technical information clearly to business partners.

Our Nationwide Financial (NF) Actuarial team members have opportunities to use state-of-the-art tools, are encouraged to innovate and learn to master actuarial methodologies. If this sounds like a place you could thrive, then we want to know more about you!

As an Actuarial Senior Consultant, you’ll need to have detailed familiarity with business operations, systems, and actuarial methodologies. We’ll count on you to be adept at sophisticated actuarial techniques and work independently to combine advanced actuarial and business knowledge to provide high-level analysis. Additionally, you’ll provide consultation and recommendations on deliverables and maintain detailed documentation of actuarial models and analyses. You’ll work independently and may lead others.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Compiles, categorizes, and analyzes sophisticated data sets.

  • Builds complicated testing tools and conducts detailed analysis of product calculations.

  • Constructs, maintains, and performs Actuarial, Projection, and Valuation Models.

  • Builds financial reporting tools and completes analysis.

  • Prices and implements products.

  • Conducts complicated risk analysis.

  • Establishes reserves and other valuation items under multiple accounting regimes (statutory, GAAP, and tax) for products.

  • Performs reinsurance analysis and pricing.

  • Crafts effective communication strategies and recommendations to leadership. Develops supporting documentation.

  • Leads cross functional peer reviews to increase collaboration, ensure quality work, and drive innovation.

  • Builds business relationships and leads cross functional communication with team members, customers, and business partners.

  • Leads onboarding and training for new associates on standard work processes. Assists in creating new training materials.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education: Undergraduate degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, or similar background requiring modeling, programming, or quantitative analysis.

Experience: Typically, four to seven years of actuarial experience.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Proven knowledge of actuarial business functions, statistical methods of analysis, actuarial models, actuarial software and databases. Proficient in Microsoft Office products (including VBA within Access and Excel), analytical software (such as tableau) and programming languages. Should have basic competencies including: command skills, strategic agility, delegation, motivating others, business perspective, and accounting. raw.description:
Job Family:

IT Project Management

Travel Required:

None

Clearance Required:

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

The Technical Project Manager will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technical initiatives supporting the GrantSolutions contract. Efforts may include application and platform modernization, system enhancements, new capabilities, integrations, cloud adoption, cybersecurity initiatives, and operational improvements. The role requires strong project leadership and sufficient familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications to engage technical teams, understand delivery dependencies and risks, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The Technical Project Manager will coordinate cross-functional and multi-vendor teams; manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and change; and partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, engineering and operations leads, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

What You Will Do:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of technical efforts, including modernization initiatives, system and application enhancements, new capability delivery, platform improvements, integrations, and technology upgrades. This role will manage delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, coordinating work across multiple workstreams, vendors, and agile teams while maintaining service continuity and alignment with business priorities.

The Technical Project Manager will establish delivery baselines and governance, manage requirements and change, track performance and financials, facilitate technical and business decisions, and coordinate quality, security, release, operational readiness, and stakeholder adoption. This individual will support initiatives involving cloud-hosted applications, integrations, shared services, data exchanges, infrastructure, and emerging capabilities. Success requires sound judgment, technical curiosity, concise executive communication, and the ability to create accountability without displacing the responsibilities of Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, or Technical Leads.

  • Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition to operations, and closeout, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

  • Define and maintain project charters, scope, objectives, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps, and governance cadence.

  • Manage day-to-day execution across multiple agile teams, technical workstreams, vendors, and shared services; clarify roles, commitments, interfaces, and decision rights.

  • Partner with Product Owners and technical leads to translate business and technical requirements into prioritized, achievable release plans while maintaining traceability from objectives through delivered capabilities.

  • Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, procurement and vendor commitments, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions using appropriate controls.

  • Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, and timely escalation of financial risks.

  • Establish and administer integrated change control, assessing proposed changes for business value and impacts to architecture, scope, cost, schedule, security, operations, and contractual commitments.

  • Coordinate architecture, application development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, data, testing, configuration management, and operations stakeholders to meet delivery and governance requirements.

  • Drive release and operational readiness, including environment and integration dependencies, test completion, defect disposition, data migration, deployment planning, rollback and contingency planning, training, communications, support readiness, and production handoff.

  • Track technical dependencies across applications, cloud services, APIs, data exchanges, security components, environments, and shared platform capabilities.

  • Coordinate delivery planning for AWS-hosted environments and Java-based applications, working with technical leads to understand architecture, security, integration, deployment, and operational considerations.

  • Proactively manage implementation and transition risks, including workflow continuity, system-of-record decisions, overlapping capabilities, data synchronization, technical debt, testing scope, deployment sequencing, and operational impacts.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics and key performance indicators, such as milestone performance, forecast accuracy, throughput, cycle time, quality trends, defect leakage, dependency aging, and risk exposure; use data to drive recovery plans and continuous improvement.

  • Prepare concise executive dashboards, weekly and monthly status reports, decision briefs, and forecasts that clearly communicate progress, financial status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

  • Facilitate planning sessions, technical reviews, risk reviews, stakeholder forums, retrospectives, and decision meetings; document actions, owners, due dates, and outcomes.

  • Manage vendor performance against plans, deliverables, service expectations, quality criteria, and contractual obligations, escalating gaps and coordinating remediation.

  • Maintain complete, audit-ready project records, including baselines, plans, RAID logs, decisions, approvals, change records, status reports, meeting outcomes, and lessons learned.

  • Build trusted relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, architects, delivery teams, and operations partners while promoting accountability, constructive conflict resolution, team empowerment, and a culture of continuous improvement.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD Public Trust; approved adjudication is required before onboarding. An active Public Trust or suitability determination is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, project management, or a related field.

  • Minimum of Twelve (12) years of prior relevant experience

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience managing complex software development, cloud, systems integration, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success managing end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholder groups, including projects in which legacy and modern platforms operate concurrently.

  • Strong command of project management disciplines, including scope, schedule, cost, resource, quality, procurement, risk, communications, stakeholder, and change management.

  • Experience using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid, and predictive delivery approaches, with the judgment to tailor practices to project risk, complexity, governance, and contractual needs.

  • Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and modern delivery practices, including cloud environments, application development, integrations, testing, release management, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and operational readiness.

  • Experience managing technical initiatives involving AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications, with the ability to understand dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and operational impacts at a project-management level.

  • Ability to understand architecture diagrams, interface dependencies, technical tradeoffs, nonfunctional requirements, and security or compliance constraints, and translate them into actionable plans without serving as the solution architect.

  • Experience establishing governance, baselines, stage gates, acceptance criteria, metrics, dashboards, and audit-ready project documentation.

  • Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, estimating, forecasting, variance analysis, EAC, ETC, and resource capacity planning.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • PMP certification; PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, ITIL, or comparable agile, service management, or scaled delivery certification.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, evaluate options, manage ambiguity, resolve conflict, negotiate commitments, and drive timely risk-based decisions.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, with a collaborative, accountable, customer-focused, and solution-oriented leadership style.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project or an equivalent scheduling tool and working proficiency with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and dashboard or reporting tools.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

  • Experience delivering federal or regulated technology programs aligned with government lifecycle, cybersecurity, accessibility, privacy, records management, and audit requirements.

  • Experience supporting delivery of AWS-hosted applications, Java-based systems, APIs, integrations, or DevSecOps-enabled initiatives.

  • AWS or related cloud certification and familiarity with enterprise Java application environments.

  • Experience managing API-enabled integration layers, data exchange patterns, canonical data models, identity and access integration, or interface-control processes.

  • Experience leading multi-vendor delivery within a shared enterprise architecture and managing contractual deliverables, service levels, subcontractor dependencies, and vendor remediation plans.

  • Experience with organizational change management, user-centered design, training, communications, adoption, and transition-to-operations activities.

  • Experience applying quantitative delivery metrics, earned value or comparable performance-management techniques, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned to improve predictability and outcomes.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

  • Collaborative leadership: Builds alignment around a shared vision, sets clear expectations, delegates effectively, and empowers teams to take ownership of outcomes.

  • Emotional intelligence: Demonstrates self-awareness, empathy, composure, and situational awareness when navigating high-pressure environments and diverse perspectives.

  • Communication and active listening: Communicates with clarity and transparency, tailors messages to the audience, asks thoughtful questions, and confirms shared understanding.

  • Influence and negotiation: Builds consensus and secures commitments across teams and stakeholders, including situations where direct authority is limited.

  • Conflict resolution: Addresses disagreement early, facilitates constructive dialogue, separates issues from individuals, and drives practical, equitable resolutions.

  • Adaptability and resilience: Remains calm and effective amid shifting priorities, incomplete information, technical complexity, and delivery pressure.

  • Decisiveness and accountability: Makes timely, evidence-based decisions, communicates tradeoffs, follows through on commitments, and holds self and others constructively accountable.

  • Integrity and trust: Models ethical behavior, discretion, reliability, transparency, and respect in interactions with clients, partners, and team members.

  • Coaching and team development: Provides actionable feedback, recognizes contributions, supports professional growth, and creates psychological safety for questions, learning, and responsible escalation.

  • Inclusive collaboration: Values varied expertise and perspectives, promotes respectful participation, and fosters productive partnerships across technical, business, vendor, and Federal teams.

  • Soft Skills and Leadership Qualities:

This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your Role at Baxter

The Clinical Consultant provides clinical and application support for both customers and internal sales force related to the Baxter vital sign and cardiology product line delivered in a hospital or clinic setting. The clinical consultant ensures educational programs meet corporate and customer goals and acts as a liaison between Baxter protocol and their customers.

Home Base: This is a remote position with a preferred home base of Minnesota or Florida.

Travel: up to 80%

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work directly with sales team during the sales cycle and participate in presales activities (onsite meetings, conference calls, demonstrations, etc.) and clinical evaluations.

  • Provide clinical assistance and customer training regarding intended use of the vitals and cardiology product lines and conduct post-training follow-up with customer.

  • Provide account management support by identifying potential or actual customer complaints/issues and act as a liaison between sales team and customer to reach problem resolution.

  • Identify training needs within the sales force and work directly with marketing teams to develop training plans and provide new or refresh training where necessary

  • Identify needs and gather customer suggestions for product enhancements and collaborate with business and project management in making product enhancement recommendations.

  • Maintain detailed records of training and customer communication, providing updates to Salesforce.com and clinical manager.

  • Participate in clinical on-call program which requires employee to support customers for clinical calls on a one-week rotational basis (Mon-Fri)

  • Ability to travel 80% to hospital and clinical settings, overnights requited.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelors Preferred

  • Minimum of two years in critical care, emergency department, post-anesthesia, telemetry unit, or other related health practice.

  • Experience as an educator in training medical and non-medical personnel, either through formal staff development or preceptor program.

  • Possesses knowledge of cardiac arrhythmia, hemodynamic, pulmonary artery, and cardiac output monitoring

  • Excellent oral, written, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

  • Excellent organization skills.

  • Experience as an educator or public speaker.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint applications.

  • Proven ability to build relationships with people easily yet work independently and be self-motivated.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices.

The estimated pay range for this position is $88,000 - $121,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less within the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change.

Individual pay is based upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

US Benefits at Baxter (except for Puerto Rico)

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Baxter US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits | Baxter

raw.title: Direct Response Creative Strategist and Ad Writer
raw.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less.
raw.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. As far as we know, we are the only true scaling research advisory firm in the world. Not “growth,” but scale.

We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue (With many of our clients between $100M and $1B+) who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales.

Our creative library includes multiple NYT best-selling books, large podcast appearances, keynotes, live events, client/member interviews, case studies, client/member training material, webinars, founder content, and hundreds of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of hooks each week. When the market tells us a hook is working, this role turns that signal into a larger family of direct-response video ads. We are looking for someone who has already written high-performing video creative and scripts at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will not begin with a blank page. You will receive a winning hook, a proven video ad, or a clear performance signal. Your job is to understand why it worked, find the strongest evidence and source material connected to it in our media library, develop the angle, write new versions, and hand the production team a clear creative direction that can become a finished ad.

This is primarily a video-ad strategy and scriptwriting role. It combines direct-response strategy, AI-assisted research, source mining, writing, creative iteration, and performance learning. You should also be capable of handling other direct-response copywriting needs when required, but video scripts are the center of the job.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

  • Receive winning hooks, proven video ads, winners and losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests from our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Diagnose why it worked: the audience, pain, belief, promise, proof, curiosity, identity, or objection it activated. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Use AI to search our content database for supporting material across testimonials, founder podcasts, books, posts, keynotes, trainings, member stories, and excerpts from our twice-yearly live events. Stay deeply current by regularly consuming our books, every founder podcast appearance and keynote, live-event content, trainings, and the weekly case-study podcast produced for our members.
  • Build an evidence bank around the angle. This may include dozens of testimonials, short proof points, founder clips, book lines, customer language, objections, and supporting stories.
  • Write three or four new hook options, develop the body, choose the proof sequence, and create a clear flow for the video ad.
  • Package the developed angle for a Creative Producer and Editor. Give them the message, key lines, source material, intended flow, and what the ad must accomplish without prescribing every visual decision.
  • Review the finished ad to protect the strategy and clarify anything that was lost in execution.
  • When an ad wins, create new variations by changing the hook, body, proof, order, framing, or CTA, and by recombining elements from multiple winners.
  • When the paid-media team flags a winning ad for refresh, identify what should be preserved and what should change so the next version can beat it.
  • Repeat the cycle quickly. Some ads may only perform for a few weeks because we intend to scale spend aggressively.

What You Own

  • Winning-hook expansion
  • Angle development
  • AI-assisted source research
  • Testimonial and proof mining
  • Video ad scripts and copy
  • Hook and body variations
  • Creative briefs and source packages
  • Winner iteration
  • Winner refreshes
  • Performance learning
  • Claim and source accuracy

What Success Looks Like

  • A dependable flow of strong, evidence-backed angles keeps the production team moving.
  • New video ads come from proven market signals without becoming minor copies of the original.
  • Winning video ads produce useful creative families as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Research is fast, deep, traceable, and materially improves the writing.
  • Editors and designers receive enough direction to protect the message while still owning the execution.
  • The work produces qualified demand, not merely clicks or internal enthusiasm.

What We Need to See

  • Direct-response video-ad work with clear personal ownership and measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, booked calls, conversion, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.
  • The ability to explain why a hook or ad worked and how you turned that learning into the next test.
  • Experience selling a complex, intangible, high-consideration offer. Expert-led, education, or information businesses are strongly preferred.
  • Strong research judgment across transcripts, testimonials, long-form content, books, customer language, and performance data.
  • A real AI-enabled research and writing workflow that increased speed or creative range without producing generic work.
  • Fast, decisive collaboration with producers, editors, and designers.
  • Excellent judgment around claims, testimonials, attribution, and source accuracy.

This Role Is Not

  • Brand copy without a measurable action
  • Generic content strategy
  • Starting every assignment from a blank page
  • Prompt output passed off as thinking
  • A writer who disappears after handoff
  • A project-management layer between strategy and production

How to Apply

Send one direct-response video ad or campaign you personally shaped. Explain the original signal or insight, the audience, the hook, the angle, the proof, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and your exact ownership.

Then show us how you use AI to search, organize, and turn a large body of source material into a stronger ad. We want to see the workflow and the finished result, not a list of tools.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

This is a player/coach role: you will personally carry a quota and run our largest, most complex deals while building, coaching, and scaling a small team of senior Enterprise AEs and SDRs underneath you.

If you only want to manage from a forecast spreadsheet, this is not the job. If you want to sit in the deal, sharpen the message, build the playbook, and develop the next generation of Worth sellers while you do it — read on.

Responsibilities

  • As a Player (roughly 50% of your time)
    • Personally hunt, own and close a named list of strategic enterprise accounts mid-market and enterprise banks, credit unions, payment processors, lenders, and platform fintechs.
    • Carry a direct, individual quota in addition to your team's number.
    • Run discovery, scoping, demo, technical evaluation support, commercial negotiation, redlines, and contract close with assists from Solutions, Product, Legal, and Finance.

    • Be the senior voice in the room on Worth's biggest deals including ones your AEs are running and step in to unblock at any stage.
  • As a Coach (roughly 50% of your time)
    • Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of Enterprise AEs and supporting SDRs raise the bar with every hire.
    • Run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and call coaching. Listen to recorded calls, ride along on live ones, and give specific, actionable feedback within 24 hours.
    • Own forecasting accuracy. Submit a weekly call to the CRO that you can defend deal-by-deal.
    • Partner closely with Marketing on ABM, with Product on roadmap signal from the field, with CS on handoff and expansion, and with Partnerships on co-sell motions.
    • Build the operating cadence: pipeline generation targets, stage conversion targets, cycle-time targets, win-rate targets — and hold the team to them.
    • Present sales performance, pipeline health, competitive intel, and strategic recommendations to the executive team and board as needed.

  • Direct experience selling into financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, lenders, or adjacent regulated industries. Familiarity with KYB, KYC, IDV, AML, fraud, underwriting, or onboarding tooling
  • A genuine player/coach disposition you have run deals while leading a team and can point to AEs whose careers you have measurably advanced.

  • Sharp commercial instincts on pricing, packaging, paper, and procurement. You know when to hold, when to concede, and when to walk.
  • Executive presence and writing that holds up in front of a Chief Risk Officer or a board.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)

Job Title

Strategic Segment Manager — Petrochem, Mining & Metals (REMOTE TX)


Location(s)

US Remote - TX

Job Description

The Company

PerkinElmer is a global analytical services and solutions provider with offerings including the leading OneSource Field and Laboratory services business that serve the biopharma, food, environmental, safety and applied end markets to accelerate scientific outcomes. Since 1937, PerkinElmer has served as a trusted partner in laboratory analysis and management and today complements its service offerings with a broad portfolio of atomic spectroscopy, molecular spectroscopy, and chromatography instruments, consumables, and reagents. With a dedicated team of more than 5,000 team members, the Company serves customers in more than 35 countries. Additional information is available at

Location: Remote role with some travel to TX around 25%

Purpose

PerkinElmer is seeking a Strategic Segment Manager to own the full go-to-market strategy for Petrochemicals, Mining & Metals. This is a market-facing, intelligence-led role that sits at the intersection of product strategy and commercial execution.

The Strategic Segment Manager is the organisation's foremost expert on their assigned market: the customer workflows, competitive dynamics, regulatory environment, and purchasing patterns that determine how PerkinElmer wins or loses in that segment. They translate this expertise into Market Requirements Documents that shape product roadmaps, go-to-market playbooks that guide commercial execution, and value propositions that give the sales organization a compelling story to tell.

This is a cross-product-line role. The Strategic Segment Manager sees the segment horizontally — understanding how customers in their market use the full range of PerkinElmer's analytical capabilities, and identifying where the portfolio wins, where it loses, and where it needs to evolve.

Responsibilities:

Market Intelligence & VOC

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the assigned segment: customer workflows, buying behaviour, regulatory and compliance requirements, competitive landscape, and technology adoption trends

  • Execute a structured VOC program, covering current users, competitive users, and prospective customers across the segment's key geographies and sub-verticals

  • Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, industry associations, regulatory bodies, and academic partners in the segment — establishing PerkinElmer as a credible, trusted partner in the relevant scientific community

  • Conduct systematic competitive intelligence: tracking competitor product launches, pricing, application claims, and go-to-market moves — translating intelligence into actionable competitive response recommendations

Market Requirements Documents (MRDs)

  • Own the segment's Market Requirements Document — the structured, evidence-based articulation of customer needs, competitive gaps, and product investment priorities for the assigned segment across all relevant PerkinElmer product lines

  • Update and maintain the MRD on a structured annual cadence, with interim updates when significant market events (competitive launches, regulatory changes, customer feedback patterns) require immediate revision

  • Present MRD findings and recommendations to the VP Product Line teams, VP Marketing, and Sr. Director — defending investment priorities with customer evidence and commercial data, not assumption

  • Ensure MRD inputs are formally adopted into at least one VP Product Line roadmap planning cycle per year, tracking implementation of MRD-driven product decisions

Go-to-Market Strategy & Commercial Enablement

  • Develop the segment go-to-market strategy: target customer profiles, channel priorities, campaign themes, value proposition hierarchy, and commercial messaging that positions PerkinElmer's portfolio competitively in the assigned segment

  • Produce commercially actionable segment enablement tools: competitive battlecards, segment application guides, customer workflow maps, and sales playbooks that Regional Marketing Managers and the field sales organisation can deploy immediately

  • Partner with the Portfolio marketing team to brief and review segment-specific campaign content — ensuring technical accuracy, commercial relevance, and strategic alignment with the segment's priority themes

  • Drive annual growth planning for the assigned segment — identifying the highest-priority growth initiatives, the product line actions required to capture them, and the commercial resources needed to win

Thought Leadership & External Presence

  • Develop segment-specific thought leadership content: white papers, application note series themes, scientific conference presentations, and regulatory commentary that establishes PerkinElmer as a knowledgeable, credible voice in the segment

  • Represent PerkinElmer at segment-specific conferences, trade shows, and customer advisory events — speaking, networking, and gathering market intelligence

  • Contribute to PerkinElmer's customer advisory board programming for the segment — designing agendas, facilitating discussions, and translating advisory input into commercial and product management action

Success Metrics

  • MRD completion and adoption — annual MRD delivered on schedule and formally adopted in at least one VP Product Line roadmap planning cycle

  • VOC coverage — minimum 25 documented in-depth customer conversations per year

  • Segment growth contribution — revenue growth in the assigned segment vs. prior year and vs. market growth rate

  • Enablement asset quality and utilization — Portfolio marketing content briefed, commercial tools produced, and field adoption rate of segment playbooks and battlecards

  • Competitive win rate in the segment — tracked through win/loss analysis

Qualifications & Experience:

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, segment marketing, market intelligence, or applications science within analytical instrumentation, life sciences tools, or a closely adjacent scientific or industrial technology business

  • Deep domain expertise in the assigned segment — sufficient to engage credibly with customer scientists, interpret regulatory requirements, and identify commercially significant technical developments without specialist support

  • Demonstrated experience conducting structured VOC programmes and translating customer insight into rigorous, commercially actionable product strategy inputs

  • Experience producing strategic documents — Market Requirements Documents, market assessments, or competitive analyses — used to drive product investment decisions

  • Strong communication skills: able to write and present at a high standard for both technical and commercial audiences

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) providing peer-level scientific credibility with customers and with the product line PM teams the Segment Manager must influence

  • Experience working in the assigned segment — as a researcher, analytical chemist, regulatory specialist, or applications expert — giving first-hand understanding of customer workflows and decision drivers

  • Track record of external scientific engagement: publications, conference presentations, or regulatory body participation in the assigned market

  • Experience building competitive intelligence systems or structured VOC programmes where none previously existed

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $110,000.00 to $135,000.00. The final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

PerkinElmer is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. PerkinElmer is committed to a culturally diverse workforce.

About TaskUs:TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

Job Description

What can you expect in an Associate Data Engineer role with TaskUs:

So what does an Associate Data Engineer do? Think of yourself as someone responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines, and data warehouses for use by the analytics infrastructure, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it’s time to imagine what it’s like being an Associate Data Engineer.

Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: you will assist in making accurate and meaningful data available for consumption of TaskUs Business Intelligence reporting methodology. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will lead to one thing: that everything you do is to meet an enterprise’s data delivery, business analysis, and reporting needs.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Associate Data Engineer, you will:

  • Configure

    • Configures and sets up solutions based on pre-approved patterns to move data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment.

    • Management of data integration & ETL jobs – consolidation, aggregation, filtering, validation, data quality routines, dimension creation, etc.

    • Configure and Deploy automation of jobs based on pre-approved and reusable patterns framework. Executes production-level jobs by considering data dependencies, schedules, validation routines, data stream updates.

    • Design, develop and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.

    • Collaborate with technical users to define data requirements & establish business rules to be applied

    • Collaborate with key business stakeholders to deliver and continually enhance the BI platform to provide relevant and accurate insights through the delivery of new datasets

  • Test

    • Validate and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.

    • Performs unit and system integration testing, on development projects.

    • Undertaking peer reviews, assisting with testing, and ensuring documentation is current.

  • Monitor

    • Monitor Error Handling and Logging tools and processes. Troubleshoot configuration and data errors.

    • Monitor Performance and raise appropriate flags.

    • Identify opportunities to optimize the ETL environment, and implement monitoring, quality, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience in Data Engineering.

  • Knowledgeable with Python, Apache Kafka, AWS Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS S3, and Pentaho Data Integration.

  • Strong knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts with understanding of traditional and MPP database designs, star and snowflake schemas with at least 2 years of data modeling.

  • At least 2 years of hands-on development experience using ETL Tools such as Pentaho, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Fivetran or Airflow.

  • Knowledge on the architecture, design and implementation of MPP Databases such as Teradata, Snowflake or Redshift.

  • 3-year development using Cloud-based analytics solutions preferable AWS or GCP.

  • Knowledge of designing and implementing streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, or Segment.

  • Knowledgeable in Database Tuning and ETL tuning.

  • Experience of using Python in a cloud-based environment is preferred.

  • Knowledge on NoSQL DBs is preferred.

  • Knowledge, experience and exposure to AI tools is preferred but not required.

  • Someone who has the ability to work effectively across internal functional areas in ambiguous situations.

  • Someone who is a structured thinker and effective communicator.

Education / Certifications:

  • Bachelor's/College Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication) or 4-8 years experience in place of a degree.

Work Location / Work Schedule / Travel:

  • Site Location: Any TaskUs IND Site (Remote)

  • Work Setup: Work from Home

The primary mission of our Ads Creative Strategist is to ensure that we provide the highest quality creative ads possible to our clients. This involves gaining a deep understanding of each client’s unique needs, brand voice, values, and messaging, as well as maintaining an in-depth understanding of and keeping up with changing trends.

As our Ads Creative Strategist, you’ll be working closely with content creators of your own choosing, whom you’ll be required to research, reach out to, and liaise with throughout the project. You may be required to communicate directly with clients on occasion.

The Ads Creative Strategist should possess a creative flair and a comprehensive understanding of social media trends and algorithms, particularly TikTok and Instagram Reels. Additionally, you will need to be able to identify and strategize for various customer avatars’ pain points, across a variety of different niches.

Great communication skills are a must, as you’ll be communicating with potential content creators, the rest of the creative team, and occasionally with clients. The right person for this job will also have excellent organizational skills, time management skills, and be able to plan ahead effectively.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (you must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language).
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team.

  • Transcribe faithfully by reproducing all text exactly as it appears in Hangul, including any hanja and handwritten content. Flag any illegible regions.
  • Capture page metadata, including language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work. Every task is reviewed end-to-end by a second Korean expert.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Korean speaker with full command of Hangul, including hanja.
  • Experience in bilingual transcription, translation, editorial work, or AI training data.
  • Exact character-level accuracy.
  • Systematic application of taxonomy across pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like multi-column newspapers and handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Experience with AI training data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction.
  • Document production experience: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Korean-language material.
  • Knowledge of script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Korean input methods, Hangul jamo composition, and hanja handling.

Application Process (Takes 20–30 mins to complete)

  • Upload resume
  • AI interview based on your resume
  • Submit form

  • For any help or support, reach out to:

Senior Manager, Executive Compensation

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a remote Senior Manager, Executive Compensation to join our team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead equity planning operations, including cost modeling, execution of workday planning tool, analysis of year-over-year costing and calibration reports.
  • Manage the intake, evaluation, and execution of off‑cycle equity planning and solicitations, including retention, sign‑on, make‑whole, and special equity awards; ensure requests are well‑supported and aligned with internal equity and approval authorities.

title: Senior QA Engineer Performance & Scalability
description: We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test.

raw.title: Senior QA Engineer Performance & Scalability
raw.excerpt: We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test.
raw.description:
We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test. You'll own performance and scalability across our platform, 30+ microservices, event-driven flows, and the legacy dependencies that come with a real production system at scale. This isn't a "run a load test before release" role. This is a role where you make performance a first-class concern from day one, where you define the thresholds that decide pass or fail, and where you hold the bar when something is degrading and nobody yet knows why.

You'll be the performance voice in every room you walk into, design discussions, architecture reviews, incident retrospectives. When latency spikes, you're already halfway through the trace. When a new service is being scoped, performance is already in the delivery plan because you put it there.

What you can expect to be doing:

  • Own Performance from Day One - You embed performance thinking into the delivery plan before code is written, not as an afterthought before release. You make performance testing a natural part of how teams build and ship — not a gate they hit at the end.

  • Define What Good Looks Like - You own the thresholds, metrics, and SLOs that govern pass or fail. You decide what a breach means, you set the budgets (latency, error rate, throughput), and you make those signals objective enough that a pipeline can act on them without a human reading graphs.

  • Test Services in Isolation, at Production Scale - You design and build performance tests for individual services, stubbing downstream and third-party dependencies so each journey is tested on its own merits. You map load to real production traffic to find where things bend and where they break.

  • Lead Performance in CI - You integrate performance testing into CI/CD so regressions are caught automatically, early, and fast. You own the fail-fast signals and keep them trustworthy.

  • Build Reusable, Scalable Assets - You build performance tests as code, reusable components, templates, and utilities that scale across teams and services. You handle data seeding and test setup so runs are repeatable and realistic.

  • Diagnose, Don't Just Report - You root-cause regressions across the stack, reading logs and tracing requests through distributed systems to find the source yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.

  • Reach Out and Drive Outcomes - You engage the right stakeholders, engineering, platform, product - to turn findings into fixes. You don't file a report and walk away; you drive the outcome.

  • Influence Decisions - You raise performance and scalability risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and bring people with you. When a design won't scale, you say so before it ships.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in performance engineering, with a track record of owning performance across complex, modern systems, not just executing someone else's load test.

  • Deep performance testing expertise. Hands-on experience designing realistic load models, running load, stress, soak and spike tests, and interpreting results meaningfully.

  • K6 or similar - You have real, hands-on depth with k6 for building and running performance tests.

  • Monitoring and observability know-how. You're comfortable with tools like Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar, and you use them proactively to correlate test results with what the system is actually doing, not just when something is already on fire.

  • Strong programming ability. You're extremely strong in at least one language. We use TypeScript across our stack; if your fundamentals are solid in another language, we're confident you'll pick it up fast.

  • Microservices and distributed systems. You understand service-oriented architectures, dependencies, and the realities of testing a service in isolation — stubbing, mocking, contract boundaries, as well as end-to-end.

  • CI/CD fluency - You've integrated performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and understand how to keep feedback fast and signals reliable. Experience with AWS infrastructure is strongly preferred.

  • Strong communication and presence. You participate fully in agile ceremonies and cross-team conversations. You don't sit quietly when something needs to be said

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, wealth management, or regulated financial services.

  • Experience using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate performance work.

  • Contributions to internal quality guilds, communities of practice, or engineering culture initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring engineers on performance and testing best practices.

What we’re really looking for: ✍️

Beyond the skills and the experience, we want someone who operates with ownership and independence. You don't wait for permission to improve something. You see a gap in coverage, a flaky test, a missing dashboard — and you fix it. You treat the Wealth Management experience line as yours, and you hold yourself to the same standard you hold the product to.

You're not a gatekeeper. You're a quality enabler. And you make every team you work with better at shipping reliable software.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply and tell us about a time you changed how quality worked on a team, not just what you tested, but how you made testing better for everyone around you.

⏰ Working Hours ⏰

  • Monday to Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Start your weekend early!)

Enjoy a structured yet balanced workweek, with an early Friday finish to kickstart your weekend!

PERKS🎁

  • £60,000 - £70,000 per annum

  • Discretionary Performance-Related Annual Bonus

  • Workplace pension scheme - We invest in your future with a workplace pension scheme, contributing 5% on earnings up to £50,000. Plan ahead with confidence while you grow your career! 🚀

  • Private medical insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Season ticket loan

  • Free ChipX subscription for UK-based employees

  • We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, plus the days between Christmas and New Year ✈️

  • Annual training budget for courses, workshops, or conferences to help you advance your career.

  • £30 per month Chip Fitness Benefit to suit your Mental/Physical Wellbeing

  • Company laptop

  • Opportunity to have a huge impact on our product while fast-tracking your knowledge, responsibility and skills in a high-growth fintech startup 🚀

Our Interview Process: 📖

  1. Video screen with someone from our Talent team

  2. Short take-home test

  3. Video technical interview with the hiring manager

  4. Final interview with Head of AI

About Chip

Chip’s mission is to make your life wealthy

We're building the wealth super app of the future. An app to build your long-term wealth across savings, investments and pensions.

We use technology to break down barriers so users can invest like the ultra-wealthy, giving them one simple place to manage, grow and protect their wealth.

The Sunday Times listed Chip as the 6th fastest growing tech company in Britain… and we're not slowing down. Chip serves over 400,000 active customers and looks after over £6billion in assets. These customers trust us to build the most amazing product we can, so working at Chip comes with real purpose.

Chip is being built by a fast-growing team of designers, developers, customer service professionals, marketers, banking experts, and entrepreneurs. Our funding story though is a little different. Chip is one of the most crowd-funded businesses in Europe, having raised over £50m from 29,000 investors, over 9 years. Crowdfunding is in our DNA and only Brewdog has more investors than Chip.

Our vision

To be the most personal digital wealth manager in the UK

Who we are

Chip has a creative and diverse team of 180, from all different backgrounds and industries. We’re driven and passionate people, but no one takes themselves too seriously.

Don’t just take our word for it. We have a few awards under our belt, including Best Personal Finance App at the 2022, 2024 & 2025 British Bank Awards.

Our Values

Be ACCOUNTABLE

Everything you do matters, Care about the end result, Challenge the norm, Disagree, yet commit to making it happen once a decision has been made, Do the best job possible

Be BOLD

Share our Ambition and do your bit to achieve it, Innovate: challenge the norm, break the mould and make it happen, Set goals that truly align with our mission, Do your best for our customers

Be COLLABORATIVE

Work cross-functionally - we win as a team, Build strong relationships based on trust, Treat others fairly and respectfully, Hold others to account, Be supportive and inclusive, Have fun together

Equal Opportunities

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and home life. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

Note to Agencies

Chip does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to any of our live roles on our career page. Chip will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee relating to these unsolicited CVs. Chip explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Chip.

Are you looking for the best place to work? Join Addiction Recovery Care, LLC (ARC) which was selected as one of the 2024 Best Places to Work in Kentucky by the Kentucky Chamber of Commerce, based on surveys of our employees!

Are you passionate about serving in an environment of shared purpose and shared goals while driving the ARC mission and values to excellence for our clients, patients and team members? ARC has been leading the way and has become one of the fastest growing healthcare systems in Kentucky (and beyond!) in addiction treatment, mental health services and improving lives by creating opportunities for people to discover hope and live their God-given destiny!

ARC is ready to offer you “The B.E.S.T. of ARC” (Balance, Energy, Safety, Training) on day 1 when you enter through our doors. ARC is a thriving, dynamic, and fast-paced healthcare system environment where compassion, accountability, respect for the dignity of life, entrepreneurship, and stewardship are key elements of every thing we do!

We are hiring an Addiction Counselor for our growing clinical team! Our Addiction Counselors will primarily be responsible for our direct client/patient services such as performing initial assessments, diagnosis, documentation and group and individual therapy sessions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Delivers direct patient services, such as performing initial assessment, diagnosis, and documentation of each event necessary to determine placement for level of care.
  • Delivers direct patient services performing individual and group therapists sessions, and documentation of each event, as needed.
  • Effectively communicate medical necessity of services, utilizing the American Society of Addiction Medicine (ASAM) guidelines for care
  • Complete appeals process with third-party payers as needed.
  • Communicate clearly and accurately to various staff.
  • Coordinates with program administration.
  • Organizes professional development and training in diagnosis and assessment, therapy, and charting/documentation as needed.
  • Serves as a positive role model by demonstrating professional and caring attitudes and behaviors toward co-workers, patients, and guests.
  • Maintains an effective clinical organizational structure and delegate appropriate authority for completion of assigned responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of administrative, personnel, and clinical policies and procedures, and ability to comply and communicate these clearly and accurately to staff.
  • Evaluates the impact of therapeutic interventions upon the therapeutic milieu.

The above is intended to be a general outline of job duties and not a complete list.

Key Experience and Education Needed:

  • Graduate of an accredited college or university with a minimum of Bachelor's degree in Drug and Alcohol Counseling and/or Masters Degree in Clinical Counseling or Social Work.
  • Must hold KENTUCKY LICENSE
  • Must hold an active professional certification/license recognized by the state of Kentucky for providing counseling services to individuals with a Substance Use Disorder Diagnosis. Specifically, one of the following licenses: CADC, LCADC, LPCA, LPCC, CSW, LCSW, AMFT, LMFT.

Other Qualifications to be Considered:

  • Minimum of 2 years administrative and management setting familiarity, with Performance Improvement and Standards necessary.
  • Communications skills to relate to all levels of management and counseling staff.
  • Self-motivated and confident Application of Continuous Quality Improvement/Performance Improvement philosophy and ability to develop the organizational strategy.

Salary market competitive and commensurate with experience.

New Hire Bonus of up to $5,000 available during the first 12 months of employment.

ARC full-time employees enjoy very attractive benefits packages for employees and their families to include health, dental, vision, life insurance, a wide array of ancillary insurance products for life’s needs, 401(k) plan with company matching and to ensure the work-life balance - generous paid vacation, sick, holiday and maternity/paternity leave policies. Clinicians receive two self-care days each year allowing for you to take care of yourself while you have taken care of others!

Come join ARC and transform lives anchored in strong family relationships, social responsibility and meaningful career paths by empowering our nationally recognized crisis to career model!


Addiction Recovery Care, LLC and its affiliated entities are an equal opportunity employer.
