raw.description:
Build the full-stack platform behind biometric health technology used in real research, healthcare, workforce safety, and enterprise environments.

Junior / Mid-Level Full-Stack Platform Engineer

Location: Remote/distributed in the United States; Austin / San Antonio preferred

Company: Confidential biometric health technology company

Compensation: $90,000-$130,000 base salary, with additional flexibility for exceptional profiles

Opportunity

We are hiring a Junior / Mid-Level Full-Stack Platform Engineer for a fast-moving biometric health technology company building production systems around wearable physiological data, APIs, SDKs, and AI-forward infrastructure.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone early in their engineering career who already has real full-stack experience and strong fundamentals. You do not need to be a senior engineer. You do need to be sharp, practical, curious, and able to ship useful software with mentorship from experienced technical leaders.

The right person will help build backend services, frontend surfaces, APIs, SDKs, and data pipelines that support a broader biometric data platform. You will work in a lean startup environment where speed, ownership, clear communication, and good engineering judgment matter.

Why People Lean In

  • Real platform work in biometric health technology, not toy internal tools.
  • Direct exposure to AI-forward infrastructure, data pipelines, APIs, and SDKs.
  • Mentorship from senior technical leaders while still owning meaningful build work.
  • A lean startup environment where strong early-career engineers can grow quickly.
  • Remote/distributed setup, with Austin / San Antonio preferred but not required.
  • $90,000-$130,000 base salary for the right early-career or junior/mid-level profile, with additional flexibility for exceptional profiles.

What You Will Do

  • Build and improve full-stack platform features across frontend, backend, APIs, SDKs, and data systems.
  • Write Python- or Go-backed services and work with JavaScript or TypeScript on product-facing surfaces.
  • Support data pipelines and platform workflows that connect biometric data, enterprise systems, and AI-facing infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on architecture, implementation, deployment, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Ship clean, reliable code in a compliance-aware environment.
  • Debug production-adjacent issues, reason through data flow, and improve the platform over time.
  • Move quickly without waiting for every detail to be prescribed.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on full-stack software engineering experience from a professional role, internship, startup, open-source work, or substantial shipped project.
  • Strong Python or Go skills.
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, SDKs, or data pipelines.
  • Practical frontend experience, especially JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Solid fundamentals in Git, testing, debugging, deployment, interfaces, and data flow.
  • Comfort working in a lean startup where priorities move quickly.
  • Ability to communicate tradeoffs clearly and learn from senior engineers.
  • Willingness to complete a live coding assessment.

Recent grads can be a fit when they have unusually strong full-stack project, internship, startup, or open-source evidence. This is not a pure classroom-only role; the team needs someone who has already built and shipped real software in some form.

Nice To Have

  • Depth across both Python and Go.
  • AI/ML, AI tooling, data infrastructure, or model-facing platform exposure.
  • Health tech, wearables, biometric data, IoT, or device-connected software experience.
  • HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, or other compliance-aware engineering experience.
  • Austin, San Antonio, or broader Texas location.
  • Strong science, engineering, computer science, or systems-oriented background.

What Success Looks Like

  • You learn the existing platform quickly and start shipping useful work.
  • You can own well-scoped full-stack, API, SDK, backend, or data-pipeline tasks from definition through deployment.
  • You ask good questions, communicate tradeoffs, and avoid getting stuck quietly.
  • You write code that is simple, testable, and maintainable.
  • You grow quickly with mentorship while still taking real ownership.
  • You bring curiosity about AI-enabled engineering without needing to be a pure AI researcher.

Additional Details

This is a full-time role with a distributed U.S. team. Austin / San Antonio is preferred, but the engineering team is already distributed, so location is helpful rather than mandatory.

The posted salary range is $90,000-$130,000 base salary, with additional flexibility for exceptional profiles. Final compensation depends on experience, skill level, technical assessment performance, and fit for the role.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, business needs, and role-related requirements. The company does not discriminate based on protected status. Urrly reviews applications against job-related factors such as skills, certifications, and experience.

Apply Now

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

Salary: $90,000 – $130,000 / year

This is a strategic sales role focused on both winning new business and expanding existing customer relationships, including complex, multimillion-dollar and multiyear opportunities.

You will own the overall sales strategy, pipeline, forecasting, and revenue performance for your assigned accounts, with global responsibility for selected customers. Success in this role requires the ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives, understand complex business and cybersecurity challenges, and orchestrate internal and external teams to deliver high-value solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own quarterly and annual revenue targets across a portfolio of enterprise and/or global accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans based on customer priorities, industry trends, competitive dynamics, and revenue potential.
  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close net-new information security opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships with C-level and senior technology/security executives and engage NetWitness executives when appropriate.
  • Drive complex, multimillion-dollar and multiyear sales, including enterprise agreements, frame agreements, and ELAs.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and rolling 12-month forecasts and provide clear visibility into sales performance and opportunities.
  • Lead prospecting activities, including cold calling, events, seminars, partner engagement, and other demand-generation initiatives.
  • Understand each account's environment, technology footprint, business priorities, decision-making structure, and growth opportunities.
  • Coordinate Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Product Management, Finance, Legal, Sales Operations, Technical Consultants, Channel, and other resources to address complex customer needs.
  • Lead opportunity management throughout the sales cycle, from qualification and solution development through negotiation, close, and post-sales engagement.
  • Develop compelling proposals and value-based solutions tailored to local and global customer requirements.
  • Lead account teams and virtual teams to ensure strong execution, customer satisfaction, and repeat business.
  • Stay current on NetWitness solutions, cybersecurity trends, technologies, and market opportunities.
  • Resolve account ownership and sales coordination challenges while maintaining strong internal and external relationships.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of enterprise software sales experience, preferably with strong information security/cybersecurity expertise.
  • Proven success selling complex technology solutions to large enterprise organizations.
  • Consistent track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets, ideally with $3M+ annual sales responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success prospecting, developing, negotiating, and closing complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience managing strategic, named, or global accounts within multinational organizations.
  • Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to translate technology into business value.
  • Excellent consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex, matrixed organizations and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong strategic account planning, forecasting, and opportunity management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree and professional sales training are desirable.
  • Willingness to travel 25–50% of the time.

Benefits

Compensation Range: $140,000 – $180,000 USD annually

Commission: Additional commission structure available

Individual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

At NetWitness, we believe in challenging the established mindsets, approaches, and product categories in the information security industry. Every product that we deliver to market is based on a core set of principles grounded in the major paradigm shifts in play and the implications that they have for our customers.

And we live by values that support our actions every day and in everything we do.

  • Do the right thing – by our customers, employees, and shareholders...think long-term, but act with a sense of urgency.
  • What we do matters – our work makes a difference in the world.
  • We give a damn – about our customers, about what we’re doing, about each other...we’re in this together.
  • We are a fun company – building cool products with technical insight that help our customers solve meaningful problems.

Our mission is delighting our customers with everything we do. We provide thousands of customers around the world with essential security capabilities, leading with our Intelligence Driven Security Strategy and Vision, to protect their most valuable assets from cyber threats. With Net Witness’s award-winning products, organizations effectively detect, investigate, and respond to advanced attacks; reduce IP theft and cybercrime.

Equal Opportunity Employer

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with high-quality remote career opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, with team members working across the Philippines, Latin America, South Africa, Europe, and beyond. We believe great people should be able to do meaningful work from anywhere, with clear expectations, strong support, and an outcomes-first culture.

For this opportunity, you will support a high-touch Beverly Hills cosmetic surgery practice where patient experience begins from the very first inquiry.

About the Role

You will own a critical part of the inbound patient journey: responding quickly to new inquiries, building trust, booking consultations, and staying meaningfully engaged with prospective patients who are not ready to move forward immediately. The practice receives approximately 15–20 new leads per day, primarily through organic social content and Meta, so speed and consistent follow-up directly affect patient conversion.

After-hours and weekend responsiveness is especially important so prospective patients are not left waiting overnight or through the weekend.

Responsibilities

  • Own the inbound patient lead pipeline and respond to new inquiries with a strong sense of urgency across phone, text, and email.
  • Turn qualified interest into booked consultations by building trust, answering appropriate questions, and confidently guiding prospects toward the next step.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects who do not book immediately, using useful and personalized communication rather than repetitive booking requests.
  • Build longer-term nurture relationships with prospective patients who are interested but need more time before scheduling.
  • Maintain a polished, reassuring phone presence when speaking with affluent and high-expectation prospective patients.
  • Qualify incoming leads and identify where each prospective patient is in their decision-making process.
  • Keep every patient interaction, follow-up, status change, and next step accurately documented in the practice CRM.
  • Provide after-hours and weekend lead coverage so new inquiries receive a fast response even when the core practice team is unavailable.
  • Support prospective patients after their consultation when needed as they consider moving forward with surgery.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 2–4+ years of experience in inbound sales, patient coordination, appointment setting, lead conversion, medical or aesthetic sales, or another high-touch consumer sales environment.
  • Excellent spoken and written English with a polished, professional communication style.
  • Strong phone confidence and experience making and receiving customer- or patient-facing calls.
  • Proven ability to convert inbound interest into appointments or consultations through timely, persistent follow-up.
  • Experience managing leads across phone, email, and SMS while keeping accurate CRM records.
  • High emotional intelligence with the ability to establish trust quickly and communicate confidently without sounding pushy.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining exceptional responsiveness, organization, and follow-through.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, a med spa, aesthetics, or another elective medical service environment.
  • Experience coordinating patients within a medical practice.
  • Experience selling or coordinating high-ticket elective services to discerning or high-expectation consumers.
  • Familiarity with Meta or Instagram-generated leads and tools such as ManyChat.
  • Familiarity with the practice's CRM platform.

A high school diploma is required. A college degree is welcomed but is not required for a strong candidate with relevant experience.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to gifted people, regardless of location.

About the Client

Our client is a multi-brand e-commerce and digital marketing business focused on growing brands through channels such as TikTok Shop, creators and affiliates, Meta Ads, Shopify, Amazon, and organic social. The company operates in a fast-moving environment where multiple brands, campaigns, and marketing functions need to stay aligned. This role is focused on bringing structure, accountability, and operational efficiency to that growth environment.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Project Manager to bring structure, organization, and accountability to projects across our marketing and creative teams. Operating across multiple brands, departments, and marketing channels, we need someone who is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and moving pieces simultaneously.

This person will ensure projects stay aligned and on track by establishing clear deliverables, ownership, timelines, and priorities. They will help the team maintain visibility, follow through on commitments, and identify potential blockers before they become problems.

We are not looking for a generic corporate Project Manager.

We want someone who has been close to marketing, creative, DTC, creators, paid media, e-commerce, or agency work

and understands the pace and complexity of this environment. Experience simply managing tickets, scheduling

meetings, or updating project boards is not enough. The ideal candidate has worked somewhere with multiple

brands, campaigns, departments, and deadlines moving at the same time - and knows how to bring order to that

environment.

Responsibilities

* Manage multiple projects across multiple brands and departments

* Create clear timelines, deliverables, owners, priorities, and deadlines

* Keep projects and team members aligned, accountable, and on track

* Follow up on outstanding tasks and make sure important work gets completed

* Identify blockers, missed handoffs, and potential delays before they become problems

* Keep leadership updated on project status, priorities, and risks

* Improve internal processes, workflows, and organization

* Coordinate across marketing, creative, creators, paid media, social, e-commerce, and leadership

* Help ensure launches, campaigns, and important deadlines do not fall through the cracks

AREAS YOU WILL WORK ACROSS:

• TikTok Shop • UGC & creative strategy

• TikTok creators / affiliates • Trybe / creator programs

• Shopify • Organic social / social management

• Meta Ads • Creative production

• Amazon • Product launches & campaigns

* You do not need to personally execute every channel, but you should understand how modern digital marketing and

creative teams operate.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Everyone knows what they are responsible for and what matters most

* Priorities and deadlines are clear and visible

* Leadership can quickly understand where projects stand

* Blockers are identified early instead of becoming last-minute emergencies

* Teams communicate and execute effectively across departments

* Processes continuously improve as the company grows

* The organization becomes more structured without becoming slower or overly corporate

Requirements

  • 3+ years of project management, marketing operations, or similar experience
  • Experience in an agency, multi-brand company, DTC brand, performance marketing agency, or similar environment
  • Comfortable managing many projects, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time
  • Understands digital marketing and creative workflows
  • Extremely organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and strong at follow-up
  • Can hold people accountable while maintaining strong working relationships
  • Can identify inefficiencies and help improve systems and processes
  • Comfortable with changing priorities and a fast-moving environment
  • Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Notion, or similar tools

Your career at Nationwide with an award-winning training program that is designed to set you up for success and confidence in your new role. Qualified candidates will have strong customer service and communication skills and will be sales focused. This is a fully remote role.

Candidates MUST be available for the full training duration and permanent work schedule.

Job Description Summary

Whether working to sell new or retain existing business, we are customer-focused, positive, persistent and tenacious. Our products are designed to protect our customers, and we know that insurance coverage has the potential to make their worst day better. If you are technologically savvy, can connect and communicate in a fast-paced environment and adapt easily to changes, we want to know more about you!

As a Retention Agent, you'll contact customers to provide a full range of services designed to retain business and increase customer's awareness of the Nationwide brand. We'll count on you to provide an outstanding customer experience of all personal lines products in all states and segments on phone calls and online chats. You'll process policy-related additions, changes and other processing activities as needed. ABOUT CHARGER LOGISTICS:

As a world‑class asset‑based carrier, Charger Logistics delivers freight on time and on budget. With a diverse fleet and deep operational expertise, we manage a wide range of freight solutions - dedicated lanes, specialized hauls, temperature‑controlled freight, and HAZMAT cargo for some of the most complex supply chains in North America.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Freight Broker (Carrier Sales Representative) to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing carrier capacity, negotiating rates, and ensuring efficient freight movement across North America.

This is an ideal opportunity for professionals who thrive in a fast-paced logistics environment and have a strong network of carriers.

You will play a critical role in the execution of shipments by sourcing carriers, negotiating competitive rates, and matching capacity to demand in real time. Acting as a key link between carriers and internal teams, you will help solve day-to-day transportation challenges and ensure freight moves efficiently and on schedule.

This is an exciting opportunity for individuals with logistics or sales experience to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment while developing strong negotiation skills and long-term carrier relationships.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Source, onboard, and manage a network of carriers to support freight demand
  • Utilize load boards (DAT, Truckstop, etc.) to match freight with available capacity
  • Negotiate competitive rates with carriers to maximize margins
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with carrier partners
  • Coordinate shipment execution and ensure on-time delivery
  • Communicate with carriers via phone, email, and system platforms (EDI/TMS)
  • Monitor market conditions, capacity trends, and lane pricing
  • Provide high-quality service to internal teams and external partners
  • Identify opportunities to expand carrier network and improve efficiency

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in carrier sales, freight brokerage, logistics, sales, or a customer-facing role (carrier sales or brokerage experience strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of North American lanes and market trends
  • Strong phone presence -comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls
  • Experience using load boards like DAT, Truckstop, or similar platforms
  • Proven negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Strong communication and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in MS Office and transportation systems
  • Post-secondary education in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field is an asset

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Clear career growth opportunities
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Generous paid time off
  • Structured onboarding and mentorship - we invest in your development
  • Collaborative, energetic team environment

About Atria:

The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.

Atria Health is seeking a Software Engineer for our DevOps team to help build and operate the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that the rest of engineering relies on every day.

This is an individual contributor role focused on:

  • Building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation that let product teams ship safely and quickly
  • Keeping our systems reliable and observable, and helping the team respond when things break
  • Reducing operational toil through tooling, automation, and good documentation

You'll work alongside the Tech Lead and other DevOps engineers to improve and maintain infrastructure-as-code, improve our build and release process, and strengthen our monitoring and security posture. You'll partner with the Platform, Data Engineering, and domain product teams (Clinical Experience, Member Experience, and Care Delivery) to understand their needs and make their path to production smoother. You'll care deeply about both how we build and what we achieve, while working to accelerate the work of our client teams.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Automation

  • Build and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform, following the patterns and standards set by the team.
  • Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to make deployments fast, safe, and repeatable.
  • Automate manual and repetitive operational work with scripts and tooling to reduce toil across engineering.

Reliability & Observability

  • Instrument services and infrastructure with meaningful monitoring, dashboards, and alerting in Datadog, and help cut down on alert noise.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and work to ensure uptime for our applications.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for our core infrastructure and build systems.

Developer Enablement

  • Support product engineering teams with deployment pipelines, environment issues, and build troubleshooting.
  • Help maintain preview and staging environments, including reliable data sync, masking, and cleanup routines so teams can test against realistic data.
  • Improve developer experience through better tooling, clear runbooks, and documentation.

Quality & Collaboration

  • Write well-tested, well-reviewed infrastructure code, and participate in design reviews and RFCs with a pragmatic, operations-focused perspective.
  • Design systems and changes to meet the team’s goals.
  • Give and receive thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge through pairing and documentation.

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python, Bash
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, Cloudflare
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
  • Observability & Incident Management: Datadog, Sentry, Rootly
  • Integrations: Athena EMR, wearable platforms, third-party healthcare APIs

Requirements

Core Experience

  • ~3 - 4 years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or backend engineering in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning and operating infrastructure in at least one cloud provider (ideally Google Cloud Platform).
  • Track record of shipping automation, pipelines, or infrastructure that made a team more productive or reliable.
  • An enthusiasm for developer productivity and making our teams as impactful as possible.

Technical Skills

  • Comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (ideally Terraform) and building CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions).
  • Proficient software engineering skills, and comfortable working in Linux.
  • Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tooling, and solid debugging instincts across logs, traces, and metrics.
  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and containerized workloads.
  • Solid grounding in reliability, performance, and security fundamentals.

Benefits

At Atria, we are proud to offer every member of the Atria team:

  • Excellent health and wellness benefits, fully covered by Atria, effective date of hire
  • OneMedical membership for employees & dependents, giving access to 24/7 virtual care
  • Fertility & family planning
  • Company-covered preventive health screenings through partner hospitals (calcium score)
  • Fitness Perks, including Wellhub +
  • 401k contributions and 4% match starting after 6 months
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Continuing medical education (CME) and CEU support for professional licensure

Company Overview


Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.


With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.


CURRENT EMPLOYEES: Please log into Workday Click Here to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"


Job Description


The Contact Center Representative supports Shriners Children’s national 800 number as well as Shriners Children’s locations by answering inbound domestic and international patient referral calls as well as general inquiry calls for all SHC locations and departments 24 hours a day 7 days a week. Contact Center Representatives are responsible for receiving patient referral requests through a variety of sources (website webforms, website chat-bot, phone calls, Epic, fax & email), documenting patient and caller information in Salesforce database and finally determining and assigning best fit location for all domestic, Mexico-domestic and Canada-domestic patients. For all international patients, contact center is responsible for collecting patient information and assigning the referral to the Global Patient Services team. A large part of the Contact Center Representatives duties is to respond and appropriately route general questions and inquiries from all callers/ web inquirers to appropriate departments such as Donations, Human Resources, Medical Records, Compliance hotline, etc. The Contact Center Representative operates in a monitored remote office setting.

The Contact Center Representative will be working in a monitored remote office setting. The weekly schedule is Monday thru Friday 10:30PM - 7:00AM.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle all incoming telephone calls from providers, guardians, Shriners and other professionals and family members in a courteous and professional manner.

  • Communicating in a clear, cordial manner with potential patient referral sources via phone, email and website chatbot.

  • Respond efficiently and effectively to general inquiries, answer questions and offer other information, as requested or needed.

  • Responsible for escalating calls appropriately according to urgent call procedures.

  • Clearly detail and document all communication with all callers in CRM system.

  • Maintain patient confidentiality in accordance to HIPAA regulations.

  • Triage patient referrals call/web forms by assessing need for urgent care.

  • Handle inquiries regarding referrals and questions about eligibility requirements.

  • Accurately and efficiently, gather potential patient information from referring source with superior attention to detail.

  • Responsible for documenting very detailed prospective patient information (demographic information, insurance information, etc.).

  • Determines & assigns all domestic patient referrals to best fit location based on patient needs & geographic location.

  • Assigns all international patient referrals to Global patient services team.

  • Process, assign and distribute website webform referrals, Epic requests and email inquiries in a timely manner.t

  • Accept, complete, submit & route Medical Record Requests on behalf of guardians/ patients.

  • Assist with Shriners Children’s location call overflow for up to 23 Shriners Children’s locations.

  • Act as an afterhours messaging service for up to 23 Shriners Children’s locations.

  • Search, confirm and update caller information in CRM & EMR systems as necessary.

  • Initiate patient retention strategies for denied/ withdrawn cases by offering solutions (i.e., location transfer, transport assistance, etc.)

  • Provide technical assistance to International families with Customer Communities System.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2 years of work experience in a healthcare office setting

  • 1 year of medical terminology experience

  • Knowledge of customer service principles and practices

  • Fully bilingual in English plus second language (Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic - Spanish is highly preferred)

  • High School Diploma/GED

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pediatric clinical experience

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

Testing Solutions SME

Location: This role is fully remote, offering flexibility to work from any location with reliable internet access, highly preferred to be on the East Coast.

What you will get:

The full-time base annual salary for this position is expected to range between $142,200 to $165,900. In addition, below you will find a comprehensive summary of the benefits package we offer:

  • Performance-related bonus.

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance.

  • 401(k) matching plan.

  • Life insurance, as well as short-term and long-term disability insurance.

  • Employee assistance programs.

  • Paid time off (PTO).

Compensation for this role will be determined by the candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and relevant knowledge.

What will you do:

The Testing Solutions Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the primary technical authority for Lonza's Endotoxin Testing Solutions portfolio, including Limulus Amebocyte Lysate (LAL)-based testing technologies and associated QC microbiology applications. As a strategic partner to Business Development Managers and Account Managers, the SME provides deep scientific, regulatory, product, and application expertise throughout the customer journey.

This individual plays a critical role in supporting complex sales opportunities, advising customers on endotoxin testing strategies and compliance requirements, and driving successful adoption of Lonza's testing solutions across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cell and gene therapy, and medical device markets. The SME serves as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers navigate testing challenges while translating scientific concepts into clear business value.

  • Lead the technical strategy for complex, high-value sales opportunities in partnership with Account Managers and Business Development Managers to improve win rates and reduce technical and regulatory risk.

  • Serve as the technical authority for Lonza's LAL-based endotoxin testing portfolio during customer engagements, including workshops, troubleshooting, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept projects.

  • Lead technical discussions with pharmaceutical and biotechnology customers regarding bacterial endotoxin testing (BET), method validation, assay performance, and regulatory compliance.

  • Support customer adoption through demonstrations, proof-of-concept studies, method transfer activities, technical workshops, and implementation support.

  • Prioritize technical support activities based on revenue impact, strategic relevance, customer needs, and business risk.

  • Deliver advanced technical and application training for internal sales teams, distributors, and key customers.

  • Coach and mentor commercial teams on technical positioning, application differentiation, competitive advantages, and objection handling.

  • Investigate and resolve escalated technical, application, and product performance issues, ensuring sustainable, root-cause-driven solutions.

  • Act as a trusted technical partner to strategic customers to support solution adoption, portfolio expansion, and long-term success.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Quality Assurance, Service, Regulatory Affairs, and other key stakeholders to ensure technically sound, compliant, and scalable solutions.

  • Provide structured feedback to Product Management, R&D, and Marketing by translating customer insights, competitive intelligence, and application gaps into development opportunities.

  • Support new product launches by shaping technical messaging, application positioning, customer education, and sales enablement materials.

  • Review and contribute to technical documentation, white papers, application notes, competitive analyses, and customer-facing educational resources.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, industry experts, and regulatory stakeholders.

  • Present technical data, endotoxin testing applications, regulatory trends, and market insights at industry conferences, customer events, and internal forums.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biology, Chemistry, Microbiology, Biochemical Engineering, or a related technical field. Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) preferred.

  • Significant experience in a technical role, field application support, technical sales, quality control, or technical services within the life sciences industry.

  • Direct experience with bacterial endotoxin testing (BET), Limulus Amebocyte Lysate (LAL) assays, rapid microbial testing, or pharmaceutical QC microbiology strongly preferred.

  • Deep understanding of GMP-regulated manufacturing environments and quality systems.

  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, biologics, vaccine, cell and gene therapy, or medical device manufacturers.

  • Strong understanding of method validation, assay qualification, data interpretation, laboratory investigations, and troubleshooting related to endotoxin testing.

  • Exceptional presentation, communication, and training delivery skills for both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Proven ability to translate complex scientific and technical concepts into clear, customer-focused business value propositions.

  • Demonstrated success leading technical workshops, customer engagements, and large-group presentations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex technical issues.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across scientific, operational, and commercial teams.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Expert-level knowledge of life science applications and the ability to quickly develop deep expertise across Lonza's testing solutions portfolio.

  • Ability to travel nationally and regionally up to 50% to support customer meetings, training activities, and commercial initiatives.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.
